intro.hr: Pojmovnik stola: cigara, piće i sparivanje. Svaki unos objašnjava pojam — definicija i kratko značenje. Maniri i govor o cigari i piću ostaju u Bontonu i Leksikonu.
intro.en: A table glossary: cigar, drink and pairing. Each entry explains a term — definition and short meaning. Manners and how to speak about cigar and drink stay in Bonton and the Lexicon.

def.hr: Tequila napravljena isključivo od agave, bez dodatnih šećera iz drugih izvora.
def.en: Tequila made only from agave, without added sugars from other sources.

body.hr:
Za večer uz cigaru birajte 100 % agave. Mixto (51 % agave) ostaje za koktele — za sparivanje je slabiji izbor.

Etiketa „Hecho en Mexico” i NOM broj pomažu potvrditi podrijetlo.
body.en:
For an evening with a cigar, choose 100% agave. Mixto (51% agave) stays for cocktails — a weaker pairing choice.

«Hecho en Mexico» and the NOM number help confirm origin.

def.hr: Visok ABV biljni destilat s pelinom i anisom — tradicionalno razblažen vodom.
def.en: High-ABV herbal distillate with wormwood and anise — traditionally diluted with water.

body.hr:
Absinth uz cigaru nije u središtu kataloga sparivanja — jak anis i bilje lako pregaze dim. Za pokušaj: lagana cigara i dobro razblažen servis.

Mit o halucinogenosti povijesna je propaganda, ne kriterij sparivanja.
body.en:
Absinthe is not core pairing app territory — strong anise and herbs can overwhelm smoke. For experiment: light cigar, well-diluted serve.

Hallucination myth is historical propaganda, not a pairing criterion.

def.hr: Postotak alkohola u piću — standardno ~40 % za mnoge destilate.
def.en: Percentage of alcohol in the drink — typically ~40% for many spirits.

body.hr:
ABV govori koliko alkohol može pregaziti dim cigare. Aplikacija koristi jačinu kao signal — visok ABV traži puniju cigaru ili razblaženje.

Proof (SAD) = ABV × 2 u klasičnom skaliranju.
body.en:
ABV sets how much alcohol will «overwhelm» cigar smoke. The pairing app uses strength as a signal — high ABV wants fuller cigars or dilution.

Proof (USA) ≈ ABV × 2 on the classic scale.

def.hr: Uređaji s ventilatorom ili elektronskom kontrolom vlage.
def.en: Devices with fans or electronic humidity control.

body.hr:
Aktivna humidifikacija koristi električne humidifikatore, ponekad s ventilatorom, u većim ormarima ili vinotekama prilagođenim cigaru. Brže reagira na promjene, ali traži održavanje i struju.

Za kućni ormar s nekoliko stotina cigare smisleno; za jednu kutiju Boveda je jednostavniji izbor.
body.en:
Active humidification uses electric humidifiers, sometimes with fans, in larger cabinets or wineadors adapted for cigars. It reacts faster to swings but needs maintenance and power.

For a home cabinet with hundreds of cigars it makes sense; for one box, Boveda is the simpler choice.

def.hr: Talijanski gorak biljni liker — korijen, bilje, citrus kora, često nakon jela.
def.en: Italian bitter herbal liqueur — roots, herbs, citrus peel, often after meals.

body.hr:
Amaro uz cigaru radi kad cigare nose zemlju ili začin — gorčina reže masnoću dima. Fernet je ekstrem amaro stila — vidi fernet.

Slatkoća varira po marki; u aplikaciji pogledajte tijelo.
body.en:
Amaro with cigars works when cigars carry earth or spice — bitterness «cuts» oily smoke. Fernet is extreme amaro style — see fernet.

Sweetness varies by brand; check body in the app.

def.hr: Sherry koji je prošao flor fazu pa oksidativno starenje — orašast, sušije.
def.en: Sherry that passed flor then oxidatively aged — nutty, drier.

body.hr:
Amontillado je most: više tijela od fino, manje slatkoće od oloroso. Klasičan uz srednje do pune cigare s cedar.

Naslov Edgar Allan Poea nije recept — tražite stvarnu bocu.
body.en:
Amontillado is the bridge: more body than fino, less sweetness than oloroso. Classic with medium-full cedar cigars.

Edgar Allan Poe's title is not a recipe — seek a real bottle.

def.hr: Lagano piće prije ili na početku večeri — otvara stol, ne zatvara ga dimom.
def.en: A light pour before or at the start of the evening — opens the table, does not close it with smoke.

body.hr: Aperitiv uz cigaru traži štednju: suho vino, blagi vermut, kratki koktel s citrusom. Cilj je probuditi apetit za razgovor, ne natjecati se s prvim dimom. Ako aperitiv već puni nepce, cigara mora biti blag.
body.en: An aperitif with a cigar asks restraint: dry wine, gentle vermouth, a short citrus cocktail. The aim is to wake appetite for conversation, not to fight the first puff. If the aperitif already fills the palate, the cigar must stay mild.

note.hr: Aperitiv otvara; digestiv zatvara — različit ritam večeri.
note.en: Aperitif opens; digestif closes — different rhythms of the evening.

def.hr: Tamni brazilski omotač, često kao maduro, sladak i pun.
def.en: Dark Brazilian wrapper, often maduro-like, sweet and full.

body.hr:
Arapiraca iz Alagoasa postala je popularna kao tamni, fermentirani omotač — čokolada, slatkoća, puna tekstura. Srodna San Andrésu u ulozi.

Deblji list može dati sporiji, hladniji dim. Često u modernim „tamnim” serijama.

Korisno ime kad etiketa kaže Brazil, ne Mexico.
body.en:
Arapiraca from Alagoas became popular as dark fermented wrapper — chocolate, sweetness, full texture. Related to San Andrés in role.

Thicker leaf can give slower, cooler smoke. Often in modern dark series.

Useful when label says Brazil, not Mexico.

def.hr: Stariji francuski brandy iz Gascogne — često pot still, rustičniji od cognaca.
def.en: Older French brandy from Gascony — often pot still, rustier than Cognac.

body.hr:
Armagnac donosi više tijela i zemlje — odličan uz punu, zemljanu cigaru. Manje marketinga, više karaktera na stolu.

Vintage armagnac je stvar određene berbe, ne samo XO kategorija.
body.en:
Armagnac brings more body and earth — excellent with full, earthy cigars. Less marketing, more character at the table.

Vintage Armagnac is a specific harvest, not just an XO category.

def.hr: Stari rum — u španjolskom kontekstu obično nekoliko godina u hrastu.
def.en: Aged rum — in Spanish-speaking tradition usually several years in oak.

body.hr:
Añejo donosi vaniliju, kokos i začinske note uz kremaste i pečene cigare. Pravila starosti razlikuju se po zemlji.

Izbjegavajte previše slatke spiced varijante kad tražite čistu bačvu.
body.en:
Añejo brings vanilla, coconut and spice with creamy and roasted cigars. Age rules differ by country.

Avoid overly sweet spiced variants when you want clean barrel character.

def.hr: Tequila s dužim starenjem u hrastu — karamel, spice, manje agave vrhunca.
def.en: Tequila with longer oak aging — caramel, spice, less agave peak.

body.hr:
Añejo tequila uz punu cigaru nosi vaniliju i dim paralelno s maduro. Previše slatki añejo može sukobiti sa suhom ligom.

Extra añejo ide dalje — vidi tequila-extra-anejo.
body.en:
Añejo tequila with full cigars carries vanilla and smoke parallel to maduro. Too sweet an añejo clashes with dry ligero.

Extra añejo goes further — see tequila-extra-anejo.

def.hr: Hrastova bačva stari destilat — boja, vanilija, tanini, „finish” profil.
def.en: Oak barrel ages spirit — colour, vanilla, tannin, «finish» profile.

body.hr:
Ex-bourbon, sherry, wine i port bačve daju različite mostove prema cigari. „First fill” jači utjecaj od „refill”.

Barrel je alat, ne magija — loš destilat ostaje loš.
body.en:
Ex-bourbon, sherry, wine and port casks give different bridges to cigars. «First fill» hits harder than «refill».

Barrel is a tool, not magic — poor spirit stays poor.

def.hr: Figurado s zaobljenom, zašiljenom glavom i cilindričnim tijelom.
def.en: A figurado with rounded, tapered head and cylindrical body.

body.hr:
Belicoso spaja eleganciju figurada s praktičnošću pareja. Glava se obično reže malo, povlačenje ostaje ugodno.

Koncentracija okusa raste prema glavi, ali tijelo ostaje predvidivo. Popularan kompromis oblika.

Kad ne želite piramidu, a želite profil — belicoso.
body.en:
Belicoso blends figurado elegance with parejo practicality. Head is usually cut small; draw stays comfortable.

Flavour concentration rises toward the head, but body stays predictable. A popular shape compromise.

When you do not want a pyramid but want profile — belicoso.

def.hr: Svijetlo, gotovo kredasto obojen pepeo.
def.en: Light, nearly chalk-colored ash.

body.hr:
Bijeli pepeo često se povezuje s mineralno bogatim tlima i dobrim curenjem dušika u gnojivu — posebno u karipskom i srednjoameričkom kontekstu. Nije garancija kvalitete, ali je znak pažljive obrade.

Razlikujte ga od sivog, prljavog pepela koji može ukazivati na loše gorenje ili previše vlage.
body.en:
White ash is often linked to mineral-rich soils and careful nitrogen management in fertilizer — especially in Caribbean and Central American contexts. It is not a quality guarantee, but a sign of careful processing.

Distinguish it from gray, dirty ash that may signal poor combustion or excess moisture.

def.hr: Liker od bilja, korijena i začina — Becherovka, Benedictine, pelinkovac i sl.
def.en: Liqueur of herbs, roots and spices — Becherovka, Benedictine, pelinkovac and more.

body.hr:
Biljni likeri su buffet identitet aplikacije — regionalni, jedinstveni, neat. U pariranju tražite body i slatkoću, ne pretpostavljajte „sve gorko”.

Pelinkovac i absinthe su specifične grane — vidi zasebne unose.
body.en:
Herbal liqueurs are the app's buffet identity — regional, unique, neat. In pairing seek body and sweetness, do not assume «all bitter».

Pelinkovac and absinthe are specific branches — see separate entries.

def.hr: Koncentrirani biljni ekstrakt — kapljice u koktel, ne piće za gutljaj (osim rituala).
def.en: Concentrated herbal extract — dashes in cocktails, not a sipping drink (except ritual).

body.hr:
Angostura i slični bitters definiraju old fashioned i negroni — gorčina u kapljicama. Uz cigaru relevantni kroz koktel (negroni), ne kao solo gutljaj.

Ne miješajte s amaro bocom — različita koncentracija.
body.en:
Angostura and similar bitters define old fashioned and negroni — bitterness in dashes. Relevant with cigars via cocktails (negroni), not as a solo sip.

Do not confuse with amaro bottles — different concentration.

def.hr: Nebarikirana tequila — agave, citrus, pepper; bez utjecaja hrasta.
def.en: Unaged tequila — agave, citrus, pepper; no oak influence.

body.hr:
Blanco tequila ističe agavu uz srednje cigare s paprenom notom. Za ozbiljan stol birajte 100 % agave — mixto je druga kategorija.

Neat malim gutljajem, ne kao shot.
body.en:
Blanco tequila is an agave-forward test with medium peppery cigars. 100% agave is mandatory for a serious table — mixto is another category.

Neat in small sips, not shots.

def.hr: Nefiltrirani ili blago stareni rum bez boje — baza za koktele i suvo uživanje.
def.en: Unaged or lightly aged rum without colour — cocktail base and dry sipping.

body.hr:
Blanco naglašava šećernu trsku, citrus i ferment. Uz laganu do srednju cigaru pogodan je za ljetni stol; uz punu ligu može djelovati tanko.

„Silver” i „white” nisu uvijek isto.
body.en:
Blanco highlights cane, citrus and ferment. With light to medium cigars it suits a summer table; with full ligero it may feel thin.

«Silver» and «white» are not always the same.

def.hr: Namjerna mješavina listova i regija koja određuje karakter cigare.
def.en: The intentional mix of leaves and regions that defines a cigar's character.

body.hr:
Blend nije slučajna gomila duhana — to je recept. Koji ligero, koji seco, koji omotač, iz koje regije: sve služi jednom profilu.

Isti proizvođač može imati više blendova: jedan blaži za jutro, jedan puniji za večer. Promjena jednog lista mijenja cijelu cigaru.

Kod stola blend je korisna riječ kad ne želite reći samo „jača” ili „slabija” — nego opisati stil.
body.en:
A blend is not a random pile of tobacco — it is a recipe. Which ligero, which seco, which wrapper, from which region: all serve one profile.

One maker may run several blends: a milder one for morning, a fuller one for evening. Change one leaf and the whole cigar shifts.

At the table blend is useful when you do not want to say only stronger or milder — but to describe style.

def.hr: Mješavina malt i grain whiskyja — najprodavaniji stil škotskog whiskyja.
def.en: A blend of malt and grain whiskies — the best-selling Scotch style.

body.hr:
Blend donosi konzistentnost i pristupačnu cijenu. Uz cigaru često je sigurniji izbor od agresivnog young malt-a — tražite sherry-forward blend za maduro.

Chivas, Johnnie Walker i sl. nisu „inferiorni” maltovi.
body.en:
Blends offer consistency and approachability. With cigars they are often safer than aggressive young malts — seek sherry-forward blends for maduro.

Household names are not «inferior» malts.

def.hr: Mješavina malt i grain whiskya — konzistentan kućni stil, ne profil jedne destilerije.
def.en: A blend of malt and grain whiskies — a consistent house style, not one distillery profile.

body.hr:
Blended whisky nije „slabiji single malt”: omogućuje stil koji se ponavlja iz boce u bocu. U aplikaciji to često znači pristupačniji ABV i mekšu žitaricu uz srednje do pune cigare.

Blended malt (samo maltovi iz više destilerija) nije isto što i blend malt + grain.
body.en: Blended whisky is not «weaker single malt»: it enables a style that repeats bottle to bottle. In the pairing app that often means approachable ABV and softer grain beside medium to full cigars.\n\nBlended malt (malts from several distilleries only) is not the same as malt+grain blend.

def.hr: Svježe uvezana jezgra cigare — punjenje i vezni list prije omotača.
def.en: The freshly rolled cigar core — filler and binder before the wrapper is applied.

body.hr:
Bonche je trenutak kad punjenje postaje oblik. Torcedor ga stisne, ujednači i provjeri elastičnost prije omotavanja.

Kvaliteta boncha određuje gustoću i gorenje. Previše labav — dim je rijedak; previše čvrst — dim je stisnut.

U radionici je to tehnički pojam; za stol dovoljno je reći da je bonche „srce prije kapute”.
body.en:
The bunch is the moment filler becomes shape. The roller compresses, evens, and checks elasticity before wrapping.

Bunch quality sets density and burn. Too loose — thin smoke; too tight — constricted draw.

In the workshop it is technical; at the table it is enough to say the bunch is the heart before the coat.

def.hr: Tehnika punjenja savijanjem listova u slojeve poput knjige.
def.en: Filling technique folding leaves in layers like a book.

body.hr:
Booking slaže listove ravno, preklopom — brže od entubada, češće u modernim tvornicama. Gustoća i povlačenje ovise o pritisku.

Dobar booking daje ravnomjerno gorenje; loš može stvoriti tvrde zone. Nije lošiji način — drugačiji kompromis.

Tehnički termin za razgovor o konstrukciji, ne izravno o okusu.
body.en:
Booking stacks leaves flat, folded — faster than entubado, common in modern factories. Density and draw depend on pressure.

Good booking burns even; bad can create hard spots. Not inferior — different trade-off.

Technical term for construction talk, not flavour directly.

def.hr: Biljke, začini i koštice macerirane ili destilirane s ginom — juniper, coriander, citrus.
def.en: Herbs, spices and seeds macerated or distilled with gin — juniper, coriander, citrus.

body.hr:
Botaničke note određuju hoće li gin ići uz cigaru. Citrus i korijander često rade uz srednje cigare; jako cvjetni profil može sukobiti s dimom.

Navy strength gin bolje nosi tonic i provjeru uz dim.
body.en:
Botanical notes decide whether gin «plays» with a cigar. Citrus and coriander suit medium; heavy floral may clash with smoke.

Navy strength gin carries tonic and pairing trials better.

def.hr: Internetski skraćenica za zajednicu pušača.
def.en: Online shorthand for fellowship among smokers.

body.hr:
BOTL — brother of the leaf — kolokvijalni pozdrav u forumima i klubovima; inkluzivno se koristi i izvan rodnih normi u modernim krugovima.

Nije termodinamika dima; označava društvenu pripadnost, razmjenu preporuka i etiketu stola.
body.en:
BOTL — brother of the leaf — colloquial greeting in forums and clubs; modern circles use it inclusively beyond gender norms.

Not smoke physics; it marks social belonging, recommendations, and table etiquette.

def.hr: Američki whiskey s najmanje 51 % kukuruza, destiliran u SAD-u i odležan u novim opaljenim hrastovim bačvama.
def.en: American whiskey of at least 51% corn, distilled in the USA and aged in new charred oak barrels.

body.hr:
Bourbon donosi vaniliju, karamelu i orašastost iz novo ugljenih bačava — prirodni suputnik cedru i pečenim notama u cigari. Zakonski minimum je 51 % kukuruza; većina boca znatno premašuje taj prag.

Pri sparivanju visoke proof boce uzimajte oprezno; 40–46 % ABV obično daje bolju ravnotežu. Vidi i Tennessee whiskey (filtracija preko ugljena).
body.en: Bourbon brings vanilla, caramel and nuttiness from charred new oak — a natural companion to cedar and roast in cigars. The legal floor is 51% corn; most bottles far exceed it.\n\nFor pairing, treat high-proof bottlings with care; 40–46% ABV often balances better. See also Tennessee whiskey (charcoal filtration).

def.hr: Manja proizvodnja, fokus na craft i ograničene serije, ne masovni brand.
def.en: Small production, craft focus and limited runs, not mass-market brand.

body.hr:
Boutique u svijetu cigara znači mala tvornica ili mala serija — često s imenom blendera na kutiji. Nije službena kategorija, nego stil poslovanja.

Može biti izvrstan ili neujednačen; prednost je eksperiment, ne sigurna skala.

Na stolu boutique znači „tražite karakter, ne reklamu”.
body.en:
Boutique in cigars means small factory or small batch — often blender name on box. Not an official category, but business style.

Can be excellent or uneven; advantage is experiment, not guaranteed scale.

At the table boutique means seek character, not advertising.

def.hr: Komercijalni dvosmjerni paketić za stabilizaciju RH.
def.en: Commercial two-way humidity control packs.

body.hr:
Boveda paketići održavaju ciljani RH (npr. 65 % ili 69 %) dvosmjernom razmjenom — ispuštaju ili upijaju vlagu prema potrebi. Praktični su u humidoru, putnom caseu i za oporavak previše suhih cigare.

Zamjenjujte ih kad se osuše i postanu krute; jedan paketić na prostoriju ili manji broj cigare obično je dovoljan.
body.en:
Boveda packs hold a target RH (e.g., 65% or 69%) by two-way exchange — releasing or absorbing moisture as needed. Handy in humidors, travel cases, and for reviving overly dry cigars.

Replace when dried and stiff; one pack per box or modest count is usually enough.

def.hr: Skup mirisa i okusa koji se razvijaju tijekom dima.
def.en: The set of aromas and flavors unfolding during the smoke.

body.hr:
Buket opisuje cjelokupni aromatični dojam — ne jednu notu. Razvija se kroz trećine, mijenja se s temperaturom i tempom pušenja.

Degustacija buketa zahtijeva mir i bez žurbe; usporedba s prethodnim dimom pomaže u učenju.
body.en:
Bouquet describes the overall aromatic impression — not a single note. It evolves through thirds, shifting with temperature and pace.

Reading bouquet needs calm and no rush; comparison with prior smokes aids learning.

def.hr: Prečišćeno gorivo za upaljače; bez mirisa kad je čisto.
def.en: Refined fuel for lighters; odorless when clean.

body.hr:
Kvalitetan butan bez mirisa ne kvari okus foota pri paljenju. Punite upaljač izvan cigare, ispuštajte zrak prije punjenja.

Jeftini butan ostavlja nečistoće koje zaguše plamen i miris dima.
body.en:
Quality odorless butane does not taint the foot when lighting. Refill lighters away from cigars; bleed air before filling.

Cheap butane leaves impurities that clog the flame and scent the smoke.

def.hr: Pakiranje bez papirnate podloge u kutiji, cigare u punom kontaktu s drvetom.
def.en: Box packing without paper lining, cigars in full contact with wood.

body.hr:
Cabinet selection znači da cigare leže izravno na cedar — bez papira između. Brža razmjena arome s drvetom, drugačiji razvoj u prvom mjesecu.

Često 24 ili više u ravnom sloju. Traži stabilan humidor kod kuće.

Kad kupujete cabinet, planirajte gdje će cigare odležati.
body.en:
Cabinet selection means cigars lie directly on cedar — no paper between. Faster exchange with wood aroma, different first-month evolution.

Often 24 or more in flat layer. Wants stable home humidor.

When buying cabinet, plan where cigars will rest.

def.hr: Brazilski destilat iz soka šećerne trske — nacionalni spirit i baza caipirinhe.
def.en: Brazilian cane-juice spirit — the national spirit and base of the caipirinha.

body.hr: Cachaça dijeli sok trske s rhum agricole, ali ima brazilska pravila i vlastiti kulturni kontekst. Bijela (mlada) je travnata i svježa; odležana (ouro/gold) mekša je i složenija.\n\nUz cigara: mlada uz laganu/claro; odležana uz medium s pečenim i voćnim notama. Nije sinonim za melasni rum.
body.en: Cachaça shares cane juice with rhum agricole, but follows Brazilian rules and its own cultural frame. Unaged white is grassy and fresh; aged (ouro/gold) is softer and more complex.\n\nWith cigars: young with light/claro; aged with medium smoke carrying roast and fruit. Not a synonym for molasses rum.

def.hr: Normandijski jabukov brandy — kiselo-slatko voće i hrast.
def.en: Normandy apple brandy — tart-sweet fruit and oak.

body.hr:
Calvados spaja voćnost i tanine koji mogu pratiti srednje cigare s notom cedra. Mladi calvados življi je; vieux pogodan za zimski stol.

Servirajte malo hladnije od cognaca.
body.en:
Calvados joins fruit and tannin that can follow medium cigars with cedar. Young calvados is livelier; vieux suits winter tables.

Serve slightly cooler than Cognac.

def.hr: Omotač iz Cameronija, često zrnaste teksture i začinski, slatkast profil.
def.en: Wrapper from Cameroon, often grainy texture and spicy, sweet profile.

body.hr:
Cameroon pokrov poznat je po „pjegama” i zrnastoj teksturi — estetski prihvaćen. Okus često kombinira začine, slatkoću i cvjetne note.

Tanak je i zahtijeva pažnju pri rukovanju. Na starijim etiketama znak karaktera.

Na stolu ga spominjite kad tekstura omotača izgleda „živahno”.
body.en:
Cameroon wrapper is known for tooth and grainy texture — aesthetically accepted. Flavour often mixes spice, sweetness, and floral notes.

It is thin and needs careful handling. On older labels a mark of character.

At the table mention it when wrapper texture looks lively.

def.hr: Zelenkast omotač brzo sušen na vrućini, blag, travnat profil.
def.en: Greenish wrapper quickly heat-cured, mild, grassy profile.

body.hr:
Candela — nekada AMS (American Market Selection) — dobiva zelenkastu boju brzim sušenjem umjesto klasične fermentacije. Okus je lagan, biljan.

Rijeđe se puša danas, ali ima povijest u SAD-u sredinom stoljeća. Nije „nesazreo” list u lošem smislu — namjerni stil.

Spominjite ga kad vidite zelen omotač, ne kad je plijesan.
body.en:
Candela — once AMS (American Market Selection) — gets greenish colour from fast curing rather than classic fermentation. Flavour is light, herbal.

Smoked less today but has mid-century US history. It is not immature leaf in a bad sense — intentional style.

Mention it when you see green wrapper, not mold.

def.hr: Kratko dopunsko starenje u drugoj bačvi nakon glavnog — port, sherry, wine finish.
def.en: Brief secondary aging in another cask after main maturation — port, sherry, wine finish.

body.hr:
Finish dodaje sloj bez cijene punog starenja — sherry finish whisky voli maduro cigaru. Marketing „double barrel” nije uvijek dug finish.

Provjerite koliko je vremena u finish bačvi kad je navedeno.
body.en:
Finish adds a layer without full aging cost — sherry-finish whisky loves maduro cigars. Marketing «double barrel» is not always long finish.

Verify time in finish cask when stated.

def.hr: Whisky (ili rum) u punoj jačini iz bačve, bez razblaživanja na standardnih 40 %.
def.en: Whisky (or rum) at full cask strength, not reduced to the usual 40%.

body.hr:
Cask strength otvara slojeve uz kapljicu vode — pogodan za pažljivo ispitivanje uz cigaru. Neat bez vode uz punu cigaru može previše peći.

Nije uvijek isto što i overproof, ali oba traže oprez.
body.en:
Cask strength opens layers with a drop of water — ideal for careful pairing trials. Neat without water and a full cigar may burn.

Not identical to overproof in every context, but both demand care.

def.hr: Tanki cedrov list za paljenje mekim plamenom.
def.en: A thin cedar strip for lighting with a soft flame.

body.hr:
Cedar spill je tradicionalni način paljenja: zapalite tanki cedrov trak, donesite plamen footu bez da opna dodirne plamen. Daje blagi cedar ton i ritualnu eleganciju.

U modernim humidorima često se koristi cedrov obloga; mali komadić može poslužiti kao spill.
body.en:
A cedar spill is a traditional light: ignite a thin cedar strip, bring flame to the foot without letting wrapper touch fire. Adds gentle cedar tone and ritual elegance.

Modern humidors often use cedar lining; a small piece can serve as a spill.

def.hr: Providan omotač oko pojedinačne cigare, zaštita pri transportu.
def.en: Clear sleeve around an individual cigar, protection in transit.

body.hr:
Celofan štiti omotač od ogrebotina i vlage u promjeni. Nije plastika u uobičajenom smislu — celulozni omotač propušta malo zraka.

Pušite s celofanom ili bez — stvar ukusa; neki ga skidaju zbog estetike. Ostaviti u humidoru ne smeta.

Na stolu je praktična stvar, ne znak kvalitete.
body.en:
Cellophane protects wrapper from scuffs and humidity swings in transit. Not plastic in the usual sense — cellulose sleeve breathes slightly.

Smoke with or without — matter of taste; some remove for looks. Fine to keep in humidor.

At the table it is practical, not a quality badge.

def.hr: Pjenušac iz francuske regije Champagne — metoda tradicionalna, dugo na kvasac.
def.en: Sparkling wine from France's Champagne region — traditional method, long lees aging.

body.hr:
„Champagne” je zaštićena regija, ne opći naziv za svaki pjenušac. Uz cigaru birajte brut i starije vintage kad želite tost i orahe uz srednje do pune cigare.

Ne koristite „šampanjac” za svako pjenušavo vino u salonu.
body.en:
«Champagne» is a protected region, not a generic name for every sparkling wine. With cigars choose brut and older vintage for toast and nuts with medium-full cigars.

Do not use «Champagne» for every sparkling wine in the salon.

def.hr: Monastički biljni liker — verte (jači) ili jaune (slatkiji), visok ABV.
def.en: Monastic herbal liqueur — green (stronger) or yellow (sweeter), high ABV.

body.hr:
Chartreuse je složen digestiv uz cigaru nakon jela — bilje, med, alkohol. Verte je jače biljna; jaune blaži uz srednje cigare.

Jedan gutljaj neat u maloj čaši — ne baza za koktel na stolu uz dim.
body.en:
Chartreuse is a complex digestif with cigars after meals — herbs, honey, alcohol. Verte is herbaceous; jaune gentler for medium cigars.

One neat sip in a small glass — not a cocktail base for the pairing table.

def.hr: Polukružno nož za rezanje duhana pri motanju.
def.en: Half-moon knife for cutting tobacco while rolling.

body.hr:
Chaveta je alat torcedora — oštar, zakrivljen nož za rezanje omotača i punjenja bez kidanja vlakana. Majstor je prepoznatljiv po ritmu rezanja.

Nije pribor za stol gostiju; to je radionica. Spominje se kad govorite o zanatu motanja.

Simbol ručnog rada, ne gadgeta.
body.en:
Chaveta is the roller's tool — sharp curved knife to cut wrapper and filler without tearing fibres. Master recognised by cutting rhythm.

Not guest-table gear; workshop tool. Mentioned when talking rolling craft.

Symbol of hand work, not gadget.

def.hr: Duga, elegantna vitola, tipično oko 7 inča i ring gauge 47.
def.en: A long, elegant vitola, typically around 7 inches and ring gauge 47.

body.hr:
Churchill je format za sporu večer — više faza okusa, više vremena za razgovor. Klasična slika duge, ravne cigare.

Zahtijeva pažniju konstrukciju; loš blend ovdje se osjeća duže. Dobro napravljen churchill nagrađuje strpljenje.

Na stolu ime nosi povijest, ali dim odlučuje blend, ne mit.
body.en:
Churchill is a format for a slow evening — more flavour phases, more time for conversation. The classic image of a long straight cigar.

It demands careful construction; a poor blend is felt longer here. A well-made Churchill rewards patience.

At the table the name carries history, but smoke decides, not myth.

def.hr: Dolina u Dominikanskoj Republici za duhan.
def.en: Dominican valley tobacco region.

body.hr:
Cibao (Cibao valley) srce je dominikanskog duhana — blaže, kremaste mješavine često potječu odavde. Klasičan kontrast nikaragvanskoj snazi.

Ime regije na bandu ili u opisu mješavine najavljuje uglađeniji, pristupačniji dim.
body.en:
The Cibao valley is the heart of Dominican tobacco — milder, creamier blends often originate here. Classic contrast to Nicaraguan power.

Region name on band or blend notes announces a smoother, more approachable smoke.

def.hr: Svijetlo zelenkasto-žuti omotač, obično blago fermentiran.
def.en: Light greenish-yellow wrapper, usually lightly fermented.

body.hr:
Claro je svijetla boja prirodno ili blago obrađenog lista. Okus je često blag, nešto biljniji nego kod tamnijih omotača.

Dan danas rjeđe dominira u premium linijama, ali pomaže razumjeti skalu boja omotača.

Na stolu je referentna točka: „svijetlija strana spektra”.
body.en:
Claro is the light colour of natural or lightly processed leaf. Flavour is often mild, slightly more herbal than darker wrappers.

Less dominant in premium lines today, but helps understand the wrapper colour scale.

At the table it is a reference point: the lighter end of the spectrum.

def.hr: Francuski brandy iz regije Cognac, destiliran od grožđa i staren u hrastu.
def.en: French brandy from the Cognac region, grape distillate aged in oak.

body.hr:
Cognac je klasičan digestif uz cigaru — karamel, suho voće, tanini. VS/VSOP/XO govore o minimalnom starosti mješavine, ne jedne bačve.

Služite u snifteru, room temperature.
body.en:
Cognac is a classic cigar digestif — caramel, dried fruit, tannin. VS/VSOP/XO state minimum blend age, not one cask.

Serve in a snifter at room temperature.

def.hr: Srednje smeđi omotač, često ravnoteža između blagih i tamnih profila.
def.en: Medium brown wrapper, often balance between mild and dark profiles.

body.hr:
Colorado je srednja nijansa — ne svijetla, ne crna. Često nosi toplinu, začine i malo slatkoće bez težine madura.

Mnogi omotači iz Ekvadora i Nikaragve padaju u ovaj raspon. Dobar „srednji” izbor za razgovor.

Korisno kad ne želite ni kremasto svijetlo ni čokoladno tamno.
body.en:
Colorado is a middle shade — not light, not black. It often carries warmth, spice, and some sweetness without maduro weight.

Many Ecuadorian and Nicaraguan wrappers fall here. A good middle pick for conversation.

Useful when you want neither creamy light nor chocolate dark.

def.hr: Nikaragvanska regija između Estelíja i Jalape.
def.en: Nicaraguan region between Estelí and Jalapa.

body.hr:
Condega daje srednje do puno lišće s mineralnim i zemljastim tonovima. Manje je medijski spominjana od Estelíja, ali važna u mješavina koje traže strukturu.

Za poznavatelje regija, Condega je most između snage i aromatičnosti.
body.en:
Condega produces medium-to-full leaf with mineral and earthy tones. Less media-famous than Estelí, but vital in blends seeking structure.

For region watchers, Condega bridges strength and aromatics.

def.hr: Tamni, deblji omotač iz Connecticuta, često sladak i pun kad je fermentiran kao maduro.
def.en: Dark, thick Connecticut wrapper, often sweet and full when fermented as maduro.

body.hr:
Broadleaf je sun-grown, grublje teksture nego shade. Kao maduro daje čokoladne, slatke note; kao prirodno tamniji list može biti zemljan.

Deblji je — dim može biti puniji. Popularan u modernim premium blendovima.

Korisno ime kad netko misli da je „Connecticut” uvijek svijetao.
body.en:
Broadleaf is sun-grown, rougher in texture than shade. As maduro it gives chocolate, sweet notes; naturally dark it can be earthy.

It is thicker — smoke may feel fuller. Popular in modern premium blends.

Useful when someone thinks Connecticut is always light.

def.hr: Regija uz Connecticut River za sjajnu opnu.
def.en: Region along the Connecticut River for shade wrapper.

body.hr:
Connecticut River Valley (često Connecticut shade) poznata je po svijetloj, elastičnoj opni uz sjene. Profil okusa obično blag, kremast, orašast — klasičan kontrast maduro opnama.

Ecuador Connecticut i originalni valley shade dijele ime, ne identitet.
body.en:
The Connecticut River Valley (often Connecticut shade) is famed for light, elastic wrapper grown under shade. Flavor profile is usually mild, creamy, nutty — classic contrast to maduro wrappers.

Ecuador Connecticut and original valley shade share a name, not an identity.

def.hr: Svijetlo zlatni omotač uzgajan u hladu u Connecticutu, često blag i kremast.
def.en: Light golden wrapper shade-grown in Connecticut, often mild and creamy.

body.hr:
Connecticut Shade uzgaja se pod tkaninom koja filtrira sunce — list je tanak, svijetle boje, glatke teksture. Okus je obično blag, kremast, ponekad orašast.

Često ga vide na jutarnjim ili ulaznim blendovima. Nije „slab” sam po sebi — jačina i dalje dolazi iz punjenja.

Na stolu ga spominjite kad tražite miran, svijetli omotač.
body.en:
Connecticut Shade is grown under cloth that filters sun — leaf is thin, light coloured, smooth. Flavour is usually mild, creamy, sometimes nutty.

Often seen on morning or entry blends. It is not weak by itself — strength still comes from filler.

At the table mention it when you want a calm, light wrapper.

def.hr: Sorta duhana s pikantnim, punim omotačem, tradicionalno kubanska.
def.en: Tobacco varietal with spicy, full wrapper, traditionally Cuban.

body.hr:
Corojo je sorta, ne samo boja — često crvenkasto-smeđa, oleozna, pikantna. Klasik kubanskog stila, danas i u Hondurasu, Nikaragvi.

Može biti zahtjevna za uzgoj — bolesti, sunce — pa se koriste hibridi. Okus je često izrazit.

Kad netko traži „pikantni omotač”, corojo je dobar kandidat.
body.en:
Corojo is a varietal, not just a colour — often reddish brown, oily, spicy. Classic Cuban style, today also Honduras, Nicaragua.

Can be difficult to grow — disease, sun — so hybrids are used. Flavour is often assertive.

When someone wants a spicy wrapper, corojo is a good candidate.

def.hr: Klasična srednje duga, srednje široka vitola, obično oko 5½ inča i ring gauge 42–44.
def.en: Classic medium-length, medium-width vitola, typically around 5½ inches and ring gauge 42–44.

body.hr:
Corona je stara škola — elegantan format koji naglašava blend umjesto volumena dima. Tanji profil može koncentrirati okus.

Mnoge linije i danas imaju corona kao „referentnu” veličinu. Tempo je umjeren.

Na stolu corona zvuči poznato i nenametljivo.
body.en:
Corona is old school — an elegant format that highlights blend over smoke volume. A slimmer profile can concentrate flavour.

Many lines still keep corona as a reference size. Pace is moderate.

At the table corona sounds familiar and unobtrusive.

def.hr: Deblja varijanta corone, obično ring gauge 46–48 uz sličnu duljinu.
def.en: A thicker corona variant, typically ring gauge 46–48 with similar length.

body.hr:
Corona gorda zadržava duljinu corone, ali dodaje puninu. Često je most između klasične corone i robusta.

Dim može biti bogatiji bez težine gordoa. Dobar izbor kad corona djeluje preuska.

Ime kaže sve: corona, ali „debelija”.
body.en:
Corona gorda keeps corona length but adds body. Often a bridge between classic corona and robusto.

Smoke can be richer without gordo weight. A good pick when corona feels too slim.

The name says it all: corona, but thicker.

def.hr: Zlatno-smeđa pjena na vrhu espressa — emulzija ulja i CO₂.
def.en: Golden-brown foam on espresso — emulsion of oils and CO₂.

body.hr:
Crema signalizira svježu ekstrakciju — nije slatkoća nego tekstura. Uz cigaru kratki espresso s dobrom kremom je elegantniji od dugog gutljaja mliječne kave.

Blada crema može značiti starija kava ili lošu ekstrakciju.
body.en:
Crema signals fresh extraction — not sweetness but texture. With cigars a short espresso with good crema beats a long milky sip.

Pale crema may mean stale beans or poor extraction.

def.hr: Blagi bijeli kristali ulja na opni; nije plijesen.
def.en: Fine white oil crystals on the wrapper; not mold.

body.hr:
Bloom (plume) su kristali prirodnih ulja iz lišća koji izlaze na površinu opne u stabilnom, hladnijem skladištenju. Brisu se lagano prstom; ispod opna je čista.

Ne brkati s plijesni — plume je ravnomjerna, prahasta i suha na dodir. Cigara s bloomom je sigurna za pušenje nakon što se kristali uklone.
body.en:
Bloom (plume) is crystallized natural leaf oils surfacing on the wrapper in stable, cooler storage. It wipes away lightly; the wrapper beneath is clean.

Do not confuse with mold — plume is even, powdery, and dry to the touch. A bloomed cigar is safe to smoke once crystals are brushed off.

def.hr: Slatko piće ili desert uz završnicu dima — rijetko i namjerno.
def.en: A sweet drink or dessert with the closing smoke — rare and deliberate.

body.hr: Desert uz cigaru lako postane previše. Ako idete u slatko, smanjite dim ili skratite završnicu. Čokolada i karamela mogu raditi s madurom; kremasti deserti često guše suptilniji pokrov.
body.en: Dessert with a cigar easily becomes too much. If you go sweet, shorten the smoke or lighten the final third. Chocolate and caramel can work with maduro; creamy desserts often bury a subtler wrapper.

def.hr: Veliki figurado s dugim zaobljenim tijelom i zašiljenom glavom, često oko 8–9 inča.
def.en: A large figurado with long rounded body and pointed head, often around 8–9 inches.

body.hr:
Diadema (ili Salomon) je format za strpljive — dim traje, profil se širi i sužava. Motanje je zahtjevno, cijena često viša.

Paljenje uske stope i rezanje glave traže iskustvo. Nagrada je ritual, ne brzina.

Spominjite je kad večer nema rokova.
body.en:
Diadema (or Salomon) suits the patient — smoke lasts, profile swells and narrows. Rolling is demanding, price often higher.

Lighting the narrow foot and cutting the head want experience. Reward is ritual, not speed.

Mention it when the evening has no deadline.

def.hr: Piće poslije jela — brandy, amaro, herbal liqueur — zatvara večer uz cigaru.
def.en: After-dinner drink — brandy, amaro, herbal liqueur — closes the evening with a cigar.

body.hr:
Digestiv nije „lijek”, nego stolski ritual. U katalogu sparivanja biljni i gorki segment raste — vidi amaro, Chartreuse, pelinkovac.

Ne miješajte s aperitivom prije jela.
body.en:
A digestif is not «medicine» but table ritual. In the pairing app herbal and bitter segments are growing — see amaro, chartreuse, pelinkovac.

Do not confuse with pre-dinner aperitif.

def.hr: Piće nakon jela ili u završnici večeri koje nosi biljnu, gorak ili topli rub uz dim.
def.en: A post-meal or late-evening pour with herbal, bitter, or warm edges beside smoke.

body.hr: Digestiv uz cigaru nije svaki liker iz police — to su boca koje znaju stajati uz dim bez da postanu desert. Biljni gorci, blagi amari i određeni konjaci imaju mjesto; kremasti likeri rijetko.
body.en: A digestif with a cigar is not every bottle on the shelf — these are pours that can stand beside smoke without becoming dessert. Herbal bitters, gentle amari, and certain brandies belong; creamy liqueurs rarely do.

def.hr: Mezcal s dimom iz pečenja agave srca u zemljanim jamama (palenque tradicija).
def.en: Mezcal with smoke from roasting agave hearts in earthen pits (palenque tradition).

body.hr:
Dimni mezcal i dim cigare zahtijevaju pažljivo usklađivanje — oba mogu biti savršena ili previše. Pravilo: jedan dominantan dim, drugi suptilan.

Espadín je najčešća sorta; wild agave varira.
body.en:
Smoky mezcal and cigar smoke need careful alignment — both can be perfect or too much. Rule: one dominant smoke, the other subtle.

Espadín is the common variety; wild agave varies.

def.hr: Država s jakom tradicijom blažih premium cigaru.
def.en: Country with strong tradition of milder premium cigars.

body.hr:
Dominikanska Republika masovno proizvodi rucne premium cigare — često kremaste, blaže, pristupačne novim pušačima. Cibao je središte, ali postoje i drugi pojasevi.

Dominican na bandu ne znači jedan okus, ali često najavljuje uravnotežen, manje agresivan profil.
body.en:
The Dominican Republic mass-produces hand-rolled premium cigars — often creamy, milder, approachable to new smokers. Cibao is central, but other belts exist.

Dominican on the band is not one flavor, but often signals balanced, less aggressive profile.

def.hr: Punjenje od cijelih dužinskih listova, tipično za premium ručno motane cigare.
def.en: Filler made from whole lengthwise leaf, typical of premium hand-rolled cigars.

body.hr:
Long punjenje znači da su listovi cijeli, a ne usitnjeni komadići. Dim je čišći, razvoj okusa slojevitiji, a pepeo obično drži liniju duže.

To ne jamči savršenu cigaru — loš blend ostaje loš — ali je temelj ozbiljne konstrukcije.

Kod razgovora o kvaliteti, long punjenje razlikuje premium cigaru od jeftinijih kratkih punjenja.
body.en:
Long filler means whole leaves, not chopped scraps. Smoke is cleaner, flavour development more layered, and ash often holds its line longer.

It does not guarantee a perfect cigar — a poor blend remains poor — but it is the foundation of serious construction.

In quality talk, long filler separates premium cigars from cheaper short-filler products.

def.hr: Lasioderma serricorne; štetnik u humidoru.
def.en: Lasioderma serricorne; a humidor pest.

body.hr:
Duhanova bubica (duhanski kornjaš) u ličinačkom stadiju buši sitne rupe kroz cigaru i lišće. Toplina iznad otprilike 18 °C potiče razvoj.

Posumnjate li na bušotine, stavite cigare u zamrzivač nekoliko dana (u zatvorenom pakiranju), odmrznuti polako, zatim očistite humidor. Prevencija: stabilna niža temperatura i RH.
body.en:
The tobacco beetle (Lasioderma serricorne) larvae drill pinholes through cigars and leaf. Warmth above roughly 18 °C encourages hatch.

If you suspect pinholes, freeze cigars for several days (sealed), thaw slowly, then clean the humidor. Prevention: stable cooler temperature and RH.

def.hr: Mjerena duljina cigare od glave do stope, obično u inčima.
def.en: Measured cigar length from head to foot, usually in inches.

body.hr:
Duljina određuje koliko dugo dim traje i kako se okus razvija. Kraće cigare brže dolaze do završetka; duže daju više faza.

Ista duljina u različitim ring gaugeima nije isti doživljaj — kombinacija oba određuje vitolu.

Churchill (~7„) i robusto (~5”) razlikuju se tempom večeri, ne samo imenom.
body.en:
Length sets how long smoke lasts and how flavour unfolds. Shorter cigars reach the finish sooner; longer ones offer more phases.

Same length in different ring gauges is not the same experience — both together define the vitola.

Churchill (~7") and robusto (~5") differ in evening pace, not only name.

def.hr: Destilat voća (kruška, šljiva, trešnja) — čist, aromatičan, obično bez dugog starenja.
def.en: Fruit distillate (pear, plum, cherry) — clean, aromatic, usually little aging.

body.hr:
Eau-de-vie je digestiv preciznosti, ne bačve. Uz cigaru rijetko prvi izbor — osim laganih večeri s claro omotom.

Grappa je grožđani rođak; pisco je grožđani destilat iz Perua/Čilea, u katalogu često izvan sparivanja.
body.en:
Eau-de-vie is precision digestif, not cask. Rarely first cigar choice — except light evenings with claro.

Grappa is the grape cousin; pisco is grape distillate from Peru/Chile, often outside the pairing catalog.

def.hr: Omotač uzgajan u Ekvadoru, često tanak, elastičan i vizualno besprijekoran.
def.en: Wrapper grown in Ecuador, often thin, elastic, and visually flawless.

body.hr:
Ekvador nudi visinu i oblake koji daju difuzno sunce — list je tanak, malo žilav, estetski čist. Zato ga vole premium linije.

Okus ovisi o sorti (habano, connecticut seed, itd.), ne samo o zemlji. Često blag do srednje pun.

Na stolu „ekvadorski” objašnjava finu teksturu, ne samo zemlju.
body.en:
Ecuador offers altitude and cloud cover for diffuse sun — leaf is thin, low-vein, visually clean. Premium lines favour it.

Flavour depends on seed (habano, Connecticut seed, etc.), not country alone. Often mild to medium-full.

At the table Ecuadorian explains fine texture, not country alone.

def.hr: Tehnika punjenja gdje se svaki list savija u cijev prije uvezivanja.
def.en: Filling technique where each leaf is rolled into a tube before binding.

body.hr:
Entubado je zahtjevna metoda — svaki list punjenja postaje mala cijev, zrak prolazi kanalima. Povlačenje dima može biti izvrsno, okus slojevit.

Rijetko u masovnoj proizvodnji; znak pažljivog boncha. Cigaru ne treba „masirati” prije rezanja.

Na stolu spominjite kad dim povlači savršeno a punjenje izgleda gusto.
body.en:
Entubado is demanding — each filler leaf becomes a small tube, air travels in channels. Draw can be excellent, flavour layered.

Rare in mass production; sign of careful bunch. Cigar needs no massage before cutting.

At the table mention when draw is perfect and filler looks dense.

def.hr: Koncentrirana kava pod tlakom — mala količina, intenzivan okus, crema.
def.en: Pressure-brewed concentrated coffee — small volume, intense flavour, crema.

body.hr:
Espresso uz cigaru poslije jela je klasičan europski ritual — gorčina kave balansira slatkoću maduro. Izbjegavajte previše gorku ligu + very dark roast.

Ristretto je kraći, koncentriraniji — vidi ristretto.
body.en:
Espresso with a cigar after a meal is a classic European ritual — coffee bitterness balances maduro sweetness. Avoid very bitter ligero + very dark roast.

Ristretto is shorter, more concentrated — see ristretto.

def.hr: Glavni regija proizvodnje duhana u Nikaragvi.
def.en: Primary cigar tobacco region in Nicaragua.

body.hr:
Estelí u sjevernoj Nikaragvi daje puno, često začinjeno lišće zbog tla i mikroklime. Mnoge moderne premium marke grade identitet oko estelí punjenja i mješavina.

Na stolu ime Estelí signalizira očekivani puniji tijelo i čvršći karakter u odnosu na blaže dominikanske stilove.
body.en:
Estelí in northern Nicaragua yields full, often spicy leaf thanks to soil and microclimate. Many modern premium brands build identity around Estelí filler and blends.

At the table, Estelí signals expected fuller body and firmer character versus milder Dominican styles.

def.hr: Najduže kategorija starenja tequile — često 3+ godine u hrastu (pravila se provjeravaju).
def.en: Longest tequila aging tier — often 3+ years in oak (verify current rules).

body.hr:
Extra añejo je tequila u smjeru whiskyja — hrast dominira. Uz cigaru traži najpunije dimenzije; uz laganu cigaru gubi agavin karakter.

Cijena ne jamči dobar spoj — ponekad reposado bolje drži ravnotežu.
body.en:
Extra añejo is whiskyesque tequila — oak dominates. With cigars it loves the fullest dimensions; with light cigars agave identity fades.

Price does not guarantee pairing — sometimes reposado balances better.

def.hr: Kontrolirano starenje i zagrijavanje listova u gomilama radi razvoja okusa.
def.en: Controlled aging and heating of leaves in piles to develop flavour.

body.hr:
Fermentacija pretvara sirovi duhan u dimljivi — piloni se okreću, temperatura raste, amoniak odlazi, šećeri se razvijaju. Maduro zahtijeva duže cikluse.

Loša fermentacija daje grub, sirov okus. Dobra daje dubinu bez gorčine.

Kad pitate zašto isti omotač može biti blag ili pun — često je fermentacija.
body.en:
Fermentation turns raw tobacco into smokeable — piles are turned, temperature rises, ammonia leaves, sugars develop. Maduro needs longer cycles.

Poor fermentation tastes harsh and raw. Good gives depth without bitterness.

When you ask why same wrapper can be mild or full — often fermentation.

def.hr: Ekstremno gork amaro — mentol, bilje, često serviran ledeno hladan.
def.en: Extremely bitter amaro — menthol, herbs, often served ice cold.

body.hr:
Fernet je okus koji se uči — i spoj uz cigaru isto tako. Uz punu, zemljanu cigaru može sjajno raditi; uz slatki maduro često sukob. Ledeni fernet smanjuje osjećaj gorčine.

Fernet-Branca je mjerilo, ne jedini.
body.en:
Fernet is acquired taste and acquired pairing — with full earthy cigars it can be genius; with sweet maduro it clashes. Ice-cold fernet lowers perceived bitterness.

Fernet-Branca is the benchmark, not the only one.

def.hr: Cigaretu s promjenom profila — zašiljena glava, piramida, perfecto ili slično.
def.en: A cigar with changing profile — pointed head, pyramid, perfecto, or similar.

body.hr:
Figurado traži više ruke pri motanju i često daje drugačiji ritam dima. Promjena promjera mijenja koncentraciju okusa kroz dim.

Rezanje i paljenje mogu biti zahtjevniji — posebno kod perfecta ili diademe. Nagrada je često slojevit doživljaj.

Na stolu figurado signalizira da večer nije u žurbi.
body.en:
Figurados demand more skill in rolling and often change smoke rhythm. Shifting diameter alters flavour concentration through the cigar.

Cutting and lighting can be trickier — especially perfectos or diademas. The reward is often a layered experience.

At the table a figurado signals the evening is not rushed.

def.hr: Kava procurjena kroz filter — veći volumen, čišći profil, manje crema.
def.en: Coffee brewed through a filter — larger volume, cleaner profile, less crema.

body.hr:
Filter kava uz cigaru opušteniji je jutarnji ritual — manje intenzivna od espressa. Srednje pečenje ide uz srednje cigare; jako tamno pečenje uz maduro.

Single origin naglašava terroir — vidi single-origin.
body.en:
Filter coffee with cigars is a casual morning ritual — less intense than espresso. Medium roast loves medium cigars; very dark roast loves maduro.

Single origin highlights terroir — see single-origin.

def.hr: Okus koji ostaje nakon izdisaja.
def.en: The taste that lingers after exhaling.

body.hr:
Finiš može biti kratak i čist ili dug i slojevit — slatkoća, gorčina, mineralnost. Dobar finiš bez peckanja često znak uravnoteženog lišća.

U usporedbi s pićem: finiš cigare i finiš gutljaja različiti su slojevi večeri.
body.en:
Finish may be short and clean or long and layered — sweetness, bitterness, minerality. A good finish without bite often signals balanced leaf.

Compared with drinks: cigar finish and sip finish are different layers of the evening.

def.hr: Najsušiji sherry, biološki staren pod flor yeast — slan, bademast.
def.en: The driest sherry, biologically aged under flor yeast — salty, almondy.

body.hr:
Fino i manzanilla (fino iz Sanlúcara) su aperitivni, ali rade uz laganu cigaru s mineralnošću. Flor daje karakter koji se ne miješa s portom.

Otvorena boca kratko traje — pijte svježe.
body.en:
Fino and manzanilla (fino from Sanlúcar) are aperitif yet suit light cigars with minerality. Flor gives character unlike port.

Open bottles fade fast — drink fresh.

def.hr: Vino ojačano dodanim destilatom (obično brandyjem) — porto, sherry, madeira i slični stilovi.
def.en: Wine strengthened with added distillate (usually brandy) — port, sherry, madeira and related styles.

body.hr:
Trenutak fortifikacije određuje stil: porto se ojačava usred fermentacije pa ostaje sladak; sherry se prvo potpuno fermentira, pa se zatim fortificira i često kasnije zaslađuje.

Uz cigaru: tawny, oloroso i madeira nose orah, karamelu i oksidaciju; fino je suši i laganiji partner.
body.en: When fortification happens sets the style: port is fortified mid-ferment and stays sweet; sherry is fully fermented first, then fortified and often sweetened later.\n\nFor cigar pairing: tawny/oloroso/madeira carry nut, caramel and oxidation; fino is drier and a lighter partner.

def.hr: Zaštitno kućište za nekoliko cigare u torbi.
def.en: A protective holder for several cigars in a bag.

body.hr:
Futrola štiti opnu od mehaničkog oštećenja i blage promjene vlage. Koža, metal ili plastika — bitno je da cigare ne budu stisnute i da imaju malo prostora za disanje.

Na dan-dva putovanja često je dovoljna bez punog putnog humidora ako su cigare već aklimatizirane.
body.en:
A case protects the wrapper from mechanical damage and mild humidity swings. Leather, metal, or plastic — avoid crushing and allow a little breathing room.

For a day or two, a case alone often suffices without a full travel humidor if cigars are already acclimated.

def.hr: Nizozemski/belgijski predak gina — borovičasti spirit na žitarnoj (sladnoj) bazi.
def.en: Dutch/Belgian ancestor of gin — a juniper spirit on a grain (malt) base.

body.hr:
Genever je puniji i žitniji od London Drya: moutwijn (sladna baza) nosi kruh i žito, a borovica je nježnija. Stilovi oude / jonge / corenwijn razlikuju se po proizvodnji i dozrijevanju.

U domovini se često pije neat, blago ohlađen — uz cigaru birajte srednje cigare, ne peated ekstrem.
body.en: Genever is fuller and grainier than London Dry: moutwijn (malt base) brings bread and cereal, with gentler juniper. Oude / jonge / corenwijn styles differ in production and ageing.\n\nAt home it is often drunk neat, lightly chilled — with cigars prefer medium smoke, not peated extremes.

def.hr: Koktel: gin + tonic water, led, limun — klasičan ljetni long drink.
def.en: Cocktail: gin + tonic water, ice, lime — classic summer long drink.

body.hr:
Gin-tonic uz laganu do srednju cigaru smanjuje udar alkohola i dodaje gorčinu koja reže dim. Birajte suhi tonic i solidan gin — ne slatki RTD (gotovo miješano piće u limenci ili boci).

U aplikaciji razblaženje snižava ocjenu uz punu, jake cigare.
body.en:
A G&T with a light to medium cigar softens the alcohol hit and adds bitterness that cuts smoke. Choose dry tonic and proper gin — not a sweet RTD (ready-to-drink mixed drink in a can or bottle).

In the app, dilution lowers the score against full, strong cigars.

def.hr: Zatvoreni kraj cigare koji se reže prije pušenja.
def.en: The closed end of the cigar that is cut before smoking.

body.hr:
Glava je strana s kapicom — ona koju režete. Oblik glave (ravna, zaobljena, zašiljena) utječe na to koliko otvora stvarate i kako dim ulazi.

Preveliko rezanje otvara bonche previše i može rasuti punjenje. Premalo rezanje suzi povlačenje dima.

U bontonu je pristojno rezanje tiho, sigurno i bez drame — glava zaslužuje par sekundi pažnje.
body.en:
The head is the capped end — the one you cut. Head shape (flat, rounded, pointed) affects how much opening you create and how smoke enters.

Too large a cut opens the bunch too much and may loosen filler. Too small a cut chokes draw.

In good manners cutting is quiet, safe, and without drama — the head deserves a few seconds of care.

def.hr: Rum zlatne boje — od kratkog starenja u hrastu do dodane karamel boje.
def.en: Golden rum — from brief oak aging to added caramel colour.

body.hr: Gold je most između blanco i añejo. Birajte one s navedenim starenjem, ne samo bojom — karamelna slatkoća voli cedar i kakaovu notu u cigari.
body.en: Gold bridges blanco and añejo. Choose bottles with stated aging, not colour alone — caramel sweetness likes cedar and cocoa in a cigar.

def.hr: Sleng za blažu, laku cigaru u casual kontekstu.
def.en: Slang for a mild, easy cigar in casual settings.

body.hr:
Golf stick kolokvijalno označava blažu, manje zahtjevnu cigaru — često manji ring gauge, manje nikotina, pogodna za teren ili društvo koje ne traži punu snagu.

Nije formalni klasifikacijski termin; služi kao opis tempa i jačine, ne podrijetla.
body.en:
Golf stick colloquially marks a milder, less demanding cigar — often smaller ring gauge, lower nicotine, suited to the course or company not seeking full strength.

Not a formal classification term; it describes pace and strength, not origin.

def.hr: Vrlo debela vitola, ring gauge 60 i više, često kraće do srednje duga.
def.en: A very thick vitola, ring gauge 60 and above, often short to medium length.

body.hr:
Gordo nudi puno volumena dima — hladniji, sporiji, često mekši u ustima. Zahtijeva dobro punjenje da povlačenje ne bude preusko.

Nije „jači” samo zato što je debeo; jačina dolazi iz blenda. Gordito je manja varijanta istog stila.

Na stolu je izbor za opušteno, bez žurbe.
body.en:
Gordo offers high smoke volume — cooler, slower, often softer in the mouth. It needs good filler so draw is not choked.

It is not stronger just because it is fat; strength comes from blend. Gordito is a smaller variant of the same style.

At the table it is a choice for relaxed, unhurried smoking.

def.hr: Način na koji se opna i punjenje pale i gore.
def.en: How the wrapper and filler ignite and consume.

body.hr:
Gorenje je srž kontrole dima: ravnomjerno gorenje drži okus stabilnim, neravno gorenje mijenja profil i temperaturu. Tempo pušenja, vlaga i kvaliteta konstrukcije svi utječu na liniju gorenja.

Promatrajte rub pepela i boju opne; oni govore više nego brzina dimljenja sama po sebi.
body.en:
Burn is central to smoke control: even combustion keeps flavor steady; uneven burn shifts profile and temperature. Pacing, humidity, and construction all affect the burn line.

Watch the ash edge and wrapper color; they say more than draw speed alone.

def.hr: Gorki rub pića koji može očistiti ili sukobiti nepce nakon dima.
def.en: The bitter edge of a drink that may cleanse or clash with the palate after smoke.

body.hr: Gorkost u kavi, amaru ili biljnim likerima može biti reset — ili sukob ako je dim već sam po sebi oštar. Pri stolu gorkost traži namjeru: želite li kontrast ili mir?
body.en: Bitterness in coffee, amaro, or herbal liqueurs can reset the palate — or clash if the smoke is already sharp. At the table, bitterness needs intent: do you want contrast or calm?

def.hr: Talijanski destilat komine (kožice i sjemenke) — nije brandy od vina.
def.en: Italian pomace distillate (skins and seeds) — not wine brandy.

body.hr: Grappa je digestif preciznosti: aroma sorte grožđa (monovitigno) ili mješavine. Većina je bistra i svježe flaširana; odležane (riserva) dobiju boju i mekoću bačve.\n\nUz cigaru rijetko prvi izbor — osim lagane večeri s claro ili kao kratki završetak nakon jela. U katalogu brandy stil „grappa”.
body.en: Grappa is a precision digestif: variety aroma (monovitigno) or a blend. Most is clear and bottled fresh; aged (riserva) gains colour and cask softness.\n\nWith cigars rarely a first choice — except a light claro evening or a short close after a meal. In the catalog under brandy style «grappa».

def.hr: Omotač kubanskog tipa — ne nužno iz Kube, ali istog stila sorte i fermentacije.
def.en: Cuban-type wrapper — not necessarily from Cuba, but same varietal and fermentation style.

body.hr:
Habano omotač koristi kubanske sorte (corojo, criollo i hibridi) i fermentaciju koja daje pikantnost, puninu i složenost. Danas često iz Ekvadora ili Nikaragve.

„Habano” na etiketi ne jamči kubansko podrijetlo — znači stil. Okus je često srednje pun do jak.

Korisno razlikovati od „Havana” kao marketinške oznake.
body.en:
Habano wrapper uses Cuban varietals (corojo, criollo, hybrids) and fermentation that gives spice, body, complexity. Today often from Ecuador or Nicaragua.

Habano on a label does not guarantee Cuban origin — it means style. Flavour is often medium-full to full.

Useful to distinguish from Havana as brand marketing.

def.hr: Doživljaj da dim i piće pripadaju istoj večeri — bez napora i bez objašnjavanja.
def.en: The sense that smoke and drink belong to the same evening — without strain or apology.

body.hr: Harmonija se ne dokazuje brojem. Osjeća se kad gost ne gleda u čašu s pitanjem „je li ovo pogrešno?” Domaćin je postigao harmoniju kad nitko ne brani svoj izbor.
body.en: Harmony is not proved by numbers. You feel it when the guest is not staring at the glass asking, "Is this wrong?" The host has harmony when nobody needs to defend their choice.

note.hr: Harmonija je doživljaj; ocjena je samo mapa.
note.en: Harmony is experience; the score is only a map.

def.hr: Tehnika punjenja naborima poput harmonike, ravnomjerna i brza.
def.en: Filling technique with pleats like an accordion, even and fast.

body.hr:
Accordion — harmonika — savija listove u nabore popreko boncha. Omogućuje brzo motanje i prilično ujednačeno gorenje.

Čest u većim proizvodnjama gdje treba brzina bez potpunog entubado. Kvaliteta ovisi o pritisku i listu.

Par s bookingom i entubado čini tri glavna stila punjenja.
body.en:
Accordion pleats leaves across the bunch. Allows fast rolling and fairly even burn.

Common in larger production needing speed without full entubado. Quality depends on pressure and leaf.

With booking and entubado it forms three main bunch styles.

def.hr: Dugi koktel: destilat + gazirani mixer, puno leda, visoka čaša.
def.en: A long drink: spirit plus fizzy mixer, plenty of ice, tall glass.

body.hr:
Highball smanjuje osjećaj jačine alkohola — koristan uz cigaru na vrućini. Rum-cola ili whisky sa sodom nisu „manje ozbiljni” parovi uz laganu cigaru.

U aplikaciji jako razblaženje snižava ocjenu uz pune, jake cigare.
body.en:
A highball softens perceived alcohol — useful with a cigar in the heat. Rum-cola or whisky-soda are not «less serious» with a light cigar.

In the app, heavy dilution lowers the score against full, strong cigars.

def.hr: Instrument za mjerenje relativne vlage.
def.en: An instrument for measuring relative humidity.

body.hr:
Higrometar u humidoru često laže iz kutije — kalibracija solnim testom ili Boveda kalibracijskim kitom vrijedi truda. Digitalni modeli su praktični; analogni estetski.

Bez pouzdanog očitanja ne znate je li problem u cigaru ili u uređaju. Provjeravajte mjesečno u aktivno korištenim kutijama.
body.en:
Humidor hygrometers often lie out of the box — calibration with a salt test or Boveda kit is worth the effort. Digital units are practical; analog ones aesthetic.

Without reliable readings you cannot tell if the problem is the cigar or the device. Check monthly in active boxes.

def.hr: Test protoka zraka prije paljenja.
def.en: An airflow test taken before lighting.

body.hr:
Hladno povlačenje radi se prije paljenja: lagano povucite kroz cigaru kako biste procijenili otpor punjenja. Služi kao rani znak uske ili labave konstrukcije.

Ne treba biti dramatično; blagi, mirni udisaj dovoljan je. Ako je otpor neobičan, imajte na umu da se ponašanje može promijeniti nakon paljenja.
body.en:
A cold draw is taken before lighting: gently pull through the cigar to judge filler resistance. It serves as an early sign of tight or loose construction.

It need not be dramatic; a light, calm inhale is enough. If resistance feels unusual, remember behavior may change once lit.

def.hr: Centralnoamerički proizvođač s čvrstim, zemljastim profilima.
def.en: Central American producer with firm, earthy profiles.

body.hr:
Hondurasko lišće često donosi zemlju, drvo i srednje puno tijelo — Jamastran i okolne doline poznate su entuzijastima. Manje je u modi od Nikaragve, ali kvaliteta je stabilna.

U pariranju s pićem honduranske mješavine podnose jače destilate.
body.en:
Honduran leaf often brings earth, wood, and medium-full body — Jamastran and surrounding valleys are enthusiast favorites. Less trendy than Nicaragua, but quality is steady.

In drink pairing, Honduran blends tolerate stronger spirits.

def.hr: Utjecaj hrastove bačve — vanilija, dim, tanini u vinu.
def.en: Influence of oak casks — vanilla, smoke, tannin in wine.

body.hr:
Oak u vinu most je prema cedar i pečenju u cigari. Previše novog hrasta („oak bomb”) uz mladu punu cigaru može biti previše drva.

Oloroso i barrique-stareni crveni imaju različit oak karakter.
body.en:
Oak in wine bridges cedar and roast in cigars. Too much new oak («oak bomb») with young full cigars can be all wood.

Oloroso and barrique-aged reds differ in oak character.

def.hr: Zatvoreni prostor za skladištenje cigare uz kontrolu vlage.
def.en: An enclosed space for storing cigars with humidity control.

body.hr:
Humidor drži cigare u stabilnom mikroklimi: cedar ponekad apsorbira miris i pomaže ravnoteži vlage. Veličina ne mora biti impresivna — važna je konzistentnost.

Prije punjenja novi humidor se sezonski priprema (seasoning). Redovito provjeravajte RH i rotirajte zalihe kako ništa ne bi stajalo godinama u kutu.
body.en:
A humidor maintains a stable microclimate: cedar sometimes absorbs odor and helps balance moisture. Size need not impress — consistency matters.

Before loading, a new humidor is seasoned. Check RH regularly and rotate stock so nothing sits forgotten for years.

def.hr: Whiskey iz Irske — često triple-distilled, glatkiji i voćniji profil.
def.en: Whiskey from Ireland — often triple-distilled, smoother and fruitier.

body.hr:
Irish whiskey je pristupačan ulaz u svijet whiskeyja uz cigaru. Lagani single pot still varijante rade uz connecticut ili claro pokrov.

Peated irski izuzeci postoje, ali nisu norma.
body.en:
Irish whiskey is an approachable entry with cigars. Light single pot still bottlings suit Connecticut or claro wrappers.

Peated Irish exceptions exist but are not the norm.

def.hr: Otočna regija Škotske poznata po dimnim, morskim single maltovima.
def.en: Scottish island region known for smoky, maritime single malts.

body.hr:
Islay je zahtjevan teren za sparivanje: jod, dim, slanost. Uz cigaru voli puno tijelo i zemlju — uz lagani claro može pregaziti.

Nisu svi Islay maltovi jednako peated; gledajte destileriju.
body.en:
Islay is extreme pairing terrain: iodine, smoke, salt. With cigars it loves full body and earth — it may overwhelm light claro.

Not all Islay malts are equally peated; check the distillery.

def.hr: Nikaragvanska regija poznata po aromatičnom lišću.
def.en: Nicaraguan region known for aromatic leaf.

body.hr:
Jalapa lišće često donosi slatke, cvjetne i kremaste nijanse — koristi se za balans uz jače estelí punjenje. Tanja opna i vezivo iz Jalape nisu rijetkost.

U mješavini Jalapa omekšava profil bez gubitka dubine.
body.en:
Jalapa leaf often brings sweet, floral, and creamy nuances — used to balance stronger Estelí filler. Thin wrapper and binder from Jalapa are common.

In a blend, Jalapa softens the profile without losing depth.

def.hr: Intenzivan, esterski profil jamajčanskog ruma — bananast, fermentiran, „hogo”.
def.en: The intense, estery profile of Jamaican rum — banana-like, fermentive, often called hogo.

body.hr:
Visok broj estera daje karakter koji ljubitelji zovu funk. U pariranju radi uz punije, zemljane i pečene cigare — lagani habano može djelovati prigušeno.

Overproof jamajčanski rumovi traže oprez: mala količina, pažnja na aromu.
body.en:
A high ester count gives a character lovers call funk. Pair with fuller, earthy and roasted cigars — a light habano may feel muted.

Overproof Jamaican bottlings demand restraint: small pours, focus on aroma.

def.hr: Whisky proizveden u Japanu — često precizan, elegantan, inspiriran škotskim stilom.
def.en: Whisky made in Japan — often precise, elegant, inspired by Scotch tradition.

body.hr:
Japanese whisky naglašava finu ravnotežu i umjereni dim. Uz cigaru odličan je za večere gdje ne želite dominaciju dima ni alkohola.

Pravila označavanja starosti mijenjala su se — provjerite godinu na etiketi.
body.en:
Japanese whisky emphasises fine balance and restrained smoke. With cigars it suits evenings where neither smoke nor alcohol should dominate.

Age labelling rules have changed — check the bottle date.

def.hr: Razlikovanje alkoholne snage od punoće okusa — dva parametra koja se ne smiju miješati.
def.en: Separating alcoholic strength from flavor weight — two parameters that must not be confused.

body.hr: Visok ABV ne znači automatski „teško” na tanjuru, niti nizak ABV znači „lagano”. Jačina je udarac alkohola; tijelo je tekstura i ostatak. Pri stolu pitajte oba pitanja odvojeno prije nego što donesete presudu.
body.en: High ABV does not automatically mean heavy on the palate, and low ABV does not automatically mean light. Strength is the alcohol punch; body is texture and finish. At the table, ask both questions separately before you judge the pairing.

note.hr: Jačina može biti visoka uz lagano tijelo — i obrnuto.
note.en: Strength can be high with light body — and the reverse.

def.hr: Glavna aromatična bobica gina — smola, bor, čistoća.
def.en: The defining aromatic berry of gin — resin, pine, clarity.

body.hr:
Juniper je most prema cedar i pinu u cigari — zato gin ponekad radi tamo gdje vodka ne. Previše junipera („Christmas tree”) može dominirati laganom cigarom.

Bez junipera nema gina po EU definiciji.
body.en:
Juniper bridges cedar and pine in cigars — why gin sometimes works where vodka does not. Too much juniper («Christmas tree») can dominate light cigars.

Without juniper there is no gin under EU definition.

def.hr: Jedna strana opne gori brže od druge.
def.en: One side of the wrapper burns faster than the other.

body.hr:
Kanu gorenje (canoeing) dobiva ime po obliku pepela koji podsjeća na kanu: jedna strana opne nestaje brže, linija gorenja se naginje. Uzrok je često neravnomjerno punjenje, vjetar ili prebrzo pušenje.

Lagano rotiranje cigare i blaga korekcija plamenom mogu izravnati liniju; ako se ponavlja, konstrukcija je vjerojatno krivac.
body.en:
Canoeing is named for ash shaped like a canoe: one wrapper side vanishes faster and the burn line tilts. Causes often include uneven filler, breeze, or fast pacing.

Gentle rotation and a light flame correction can level the line; if it repeats, construction is likely at fault.

def.hr: Mala količina vode u whisky ili visok ABV destilat — otvara aromu.
def.en: A small amount of water in whisky or high-ABV spirit — opens aroma.

body.hr:
Kap vode mijenja aromu u čaši — često bolji test uz cigaru nego led. Posebno kod cask strength uz srednje do pune cigare.

Ne razrjeđujte bocu — dodajte u čašu po gutljaju.
body.en:
A water drop changes aromatic emulsion — often a better pairing test than ice. Especially with cask strength and medium-full cigars.

Do not «dilute the bottle» — add to the glass per sip.

def.hr: Mali komad omotača na glavi koji zatvara bonche i omogućuje sigurno rezanje.
def.en: The small piece of wrapper on the head that seals the bunch and allows safe cutting.

body.hr:
Kapica drži bonche zatvoren i sprječava da se omotač odmota pri pušenju. Bez nje bi glava bila ranjiva.

Pri rezanju uklanjate samo mali dio kapice — ne i cijelu glavu. Loše rezanje može oštetiti strukturu i pogoršati povlačenje dima.

Na stolu je kapica razlog zašto se govori o „glavi” i zašto rezanje nije trivijalno.
body.en:
The cap keeps the bunch closed and stops the wrapper from unravelling while smoking. Without it the head would be vulnerable.

When cutting you remove only a small part of the cap — not the whole head. A bad cut can damage structure and worsen draw.

At the table the cap is why we speak of the head and why cutting is not trivial.

def.hr: Espresso s mlijekom — cappuccino, flat white, latte; tekstura i slatkoća.
def.en: Espresso with milk — cappuccino, flat white, latte; texture and sweetness.

body.hr:
Mlijeko smanjuje gorčinu kave — uz cigaru rijetko idealno, osim uz blage, kremaste cigare. Za ozbiljniji spoj birajte crnu kavu.

Jutarnji cappuccino uz cigaru stil je, ne pravilo aplikacije.
body.en:
Milk reduces coffee bitterness — with cigars rarely ideal except with mild, creamy cigars. For «serious» pairing choose black coffee.

Morning cappuccino + cigar is style, not an app rule.

def.hr: Espresso ili filter kava kao suputnik dimu — koncentrat koji traži mjeru.
def.en: Espresso or filter coffee as companion to smoke — a concentrate that demands measure.

body.hr: Kava i dim dijele gorak rub; zato dobro paze kad je cigara pun i kada je kava kratka. Espresso s madurom je klasičan stol; duga filter kava bolje ide uz blaži dim. Šećer u kavi mijenja igru — neka bude svjestan izbor.
body.en: Coffee and smoke share a bitter edge; that is why they work when the cigar is full and the coffee is short. Espresso with maduro is a classic table; long filter coffee suits milder smoke. Sugar in coffee changes the game — make it a conscious choice.

def.hr: Svježina i „rez” vina — balansira slatkoću i masnoću hrane i cigare.
def.en: Freshness and «cut» in wine — balances sweetness and richness of food and cigars.

body.hr:
Kiselost u vinu može oživjeti usta nakon masnog dima. Fino sherry i mlado bijelo s dobrom kiselošću rade uz srednje cigare.

Previše kiselosti uz gorku ligu stvara sukob.
body.en:
Acidity in wine can «refresh» the palate after oily smoke. Fino sherry and young whites with good acid suit medium cigars.

Too much acidity with bitter ligero clashes.

def.hr: Kratki, namjerni koktel koji povezuje cigara i jače piće bez punog volumena alkohola.
def.en: A short, deliberate cocktail linking cigar and stronger pour without full alcohol volume.

body.hr: Dobar koktel-most zna svoju ulogu: dvije sastojke, jasan rub, nema slatkog preliva. Nije zamjena za degustaciju boce — to je režija večeri. Old Fashioned kratkog stasa ili suhi highball često rade bolje od kompliciranog menija.
body.en: A good cocktail bridge knows its role: two ingredients, clear edge, no sugar flood. It is not a substitute for bottle tasting — it is stage direction for the evening. A short Old Fashioned or dry highball often beats a complicated menu.

def.hr: Kad dim i piće nose slične note i grade zajedničku sliku na tanjuru.
def.en: When smoke and drink share similar notes and build a shared picture on the palate.

body.hr: Komplement je miran stol: orašasti maduro i orašasti rum, karamel Connecticut i blagi sherry — ne natječu se, već potvrđuju jedan drugoga. Opasnost je monotonija: previše sličnosti i večer postane ravna linija.
body.en: Complement is a calm table: nutty maduro and nutty rum, caramel Connecticut and gentle sherry — they do not compete, they confirm each other. The risk is monotony: too much similarity and the evening becomes a flat line.

def.hr: Namjerno suprotstavljanje dima i pića da se istaknu različiti rubovi okusa.
def.en: Deliberately opposing smoke and drink to highlight different edges of flavor.

body.hr: Kontrast nije nesloga. Slatko uz gorak dim, hladno uz topli pepeo — to su odluke koje budi pažnju, ne one koje guše. Kontrast traži mjeru: jedan naglasak dovoljan je; dva suprotna naglaska istovremeno postaju kaos.
body.en: Contrast is not discord. Sweet against bitter smoke, cold against warm ash — these are choices that wake the palate, not choices that crush it. Contrast needs measure: one accent is enough; two opposing accents at once become noise.

def.hr: Blago dopunjavanje plamenom uz rub gorenja.
def.en: A gentle flame correction along the burn edge.

body.hr:
Touch-up je diskretna korekcija: plamen samo dotakne stranu koja zaostaje, bez pečenja cijele opne. Cilj je izravnati liniju, ne prepeći cigaru.

Koristite ga štedljivo; prečesta korekcija maskira lošu konstrukciju. Pri stolu se radi nenametljivo, bez dramatizacije.
body.en:
A touch-up is a discreet correction: the flame only kisses the lagging side without roasting the whole wrapper. The goal is to level the line, not re-char the cigar.

Use it sparingly; constant correction hides poor construction. At the table, do it quietly, without ceremony.

def.hr: Drvena kutijica za jednu cigaru, premium pakiranje.
def.en: Wooden box for a single cigar, premium packaging.

body.hr:
Coffin je pojedinačna drvena kutija — često za limitirane ili reprezentativne cigare. Zaštita i ceremonijal.

Nije za dugo skladištenje bez humidora; drvo alone ne drži RH. Cigaretu izvucite u normalne uvjete.

Na stolu coffin signalizira poseban trenutak, ne svakodnevni dim.
body.en:
Coffin is a single wooden box — often for limited or showcase cigars. Protection and ceremony.

Not for long storage without humidor; wood alone does not hold RH. Move cigar to normal conditions.

At the table a coffin signals a special moment, not everyday smoke.

def.hr: Punjenje od usitnjenih komada duhana, češće u jeftinijim ili machine-made formatima.
def.en: Filler made from chopped tobacco pieces, more common in inexpensive or machine-made formats.

body.hr:
Short punjenje koristi rezanice, otpad ili sitnije komade. Dim može biti okusit, ali često kraći, pepeo labaviji, a gorenje manje predvidivo.

Nije nužno loše — neki formati namjerno koriste kratko punjenje — ali nije isti doživljaj kao long punjenje.

Na stolu ga spominjite bez snobizma: radi se o konstrukciji, ne o moralnoj ocjeni.
body.en:
Short filler uses cuttings, scraps, or smaller pieces. Smoke can taste fine but is often shorter, ash less stable, and burn less predictable.

It is not necessarily bad — some formats use it by design — but it is not the same experience as long filler.

Mention it at the table without snobbery: it is about construction, not moral judgment.

def.hr: Podrijetlo kubanskog duhana; Habano kao zaštićeni pojam.
def.en: Cuban tobacco origin; Habano as protected term.

body.hr:
Kuba ostaje referenca za tradicionalnu konstrukciju i profil — Vuelta Abajo, Partido, Pinar del Río. Habano označava kubanski duhan i proizvode prema kubanskom sustavu, ne svaku cigaru općenito.

Van Kube Cuban seed ili Habano style opisuju utjecaj, ne podrijetlo. Poštujte embargoe i autentičnost pri kupnji.
body.en:
Cuba remains reference for traditional construction and profile — Vuelta Abajo, Partido, Pinar del Río. Habano marks Cuban tobacco and products under the Cuban system, not any cigar generically.

Outside Cuba, Cuban seed or Habano style describe influence, not origin. Respect embargoes and authenticity when buying.

def.hr: Cigaretu s ravnim stranama i zaobljenim rubovima, oblik dobiven pritiskom u kutiji.
def.en: Cigar with flat sides and rounded edges, shaped by pressure in the box.

body.hr:
Box-pressed format izgleda kvadratično u presjeku, ali gori kao cilindar s blagim rubovima. Neki smatraju da koncentrira okus.

U humidoru zauzima malo drugačije mjesto. Trunk press je srodna tehnika jačeg pritiska.

Na stolu je razgovor o estetici i osjećaju u ustima.
body.en:
Box-pressed looks square in cross-section but burns like a cylinder with soft edges. Some feel it concentrates flavour.

In the humidor it occupies space slightly differently. Trunk press is a related, firmer pressing method.

At the table it is talk about aesthetics and mouthfeel.

def.hr: Premali otpor; dim teče prebrzo.
def.en: Too little resistance; smoke runs too fast.

body.hr:
Labavo povlačenje daje dim koji gotovo curi bez otpora. Cigara gubi temperaturu, okus je tanak, pepeljara često prima kratke, krhke pepeljaste trake.

Uzrok je obično labo zamotano punjenje ili premalo listova u punjenju. Nije opasno, ali iskustvo je slabije; sporije pušenje ponekad malo pomaže.
body.en:
A loose draw delivers smoke that almost pours through with little resistance. The cigar loses heat, flavor thins, and ash often comes in short, fragile stacks.

Cause is usually loosely rolled filler or insufficient leaf in the bunch. It is not dangerous, but the experience suffers; slower pacing sometimes helps slightly.

def.hr: Duga, vrlo uska vitola, često ring gauge 38–40 i duljina oko 7–7½ inča.
def.en: A long, very slim vitola, often ring gauge 38–40 and length around 7–7½ inches.

body.hr:
Lancero je test torcedora — usko punjenje mora povlačiti savršeno. Okus je često intenzivan i usmjeren.

Paljenje i ritam trebaju pažnju; žurba kvari doživljaj. Nagrada je precizan, slojevit dim.

Na stolu lancero signalizira namjeru, ne slučajnost.
body.en:
Lancero tests the roller — a narrow bunch must draw perfectly. Flavour is often intense and focused.

Lighting and rhythm need care; rushing ruins it. Reward is precise, layered smoke.

At the table a lancero signals intent, not accident.

def.hr: List s gornjih priminga, najjači i najpuniji, često daje snagu i dubinu okusu.
def.en: Leaf from the upper primings, the strongest and fullest, often giving power and depth to the blend.

body.hr:
Ligero raste visoko na stabljici, tamo gdje je sunce najintenzivnije. List je deblji, oleozniji i sporije sazrijeva.
