U punjenju ligero donosi snagu, zemljanost i dug završetak. Previše ga može učiniti dim teškim; u maloj mjeri daje strukturu.

Na stolu ga spominjite kad cigaru osjećate kao „punu” i sporo otkrivenu — to je često ligero u akciji.
body.en:
Ligero grows high on the stalk, where sunlight is most intense. The leaf is thicker, oilier, and slower to mature.

In the filler ligero brings strength, earthiness, and a long finish. Too much can make the smoke heavy; in modest amounts it gives structure.

At the table mention it when a cigar feels full and slowly unfolding — that is often ligero at work.

def.hr: Stil gina bez dodane slatkoće nakon destilacije — juniper forward, suh profil.
def.en: Gin style with no added sweetness after distillation — juniper forward, dry profile.

body.hr:
London dry je klasična baza G&T-a uz cigaru ljetnoj vrućini — tonic smanjuje ABV percipiranje. Sušina voli cedar i earth u cigari.

„London dry” ne znači da je gin napravljen u Londonu.
body.en:
London dry is the classic G&T base with cigars in summer heat — tonic lowers perceived ABV. Dryness loves cedar and earth in cigars.

«London dry» does not mean the gin was made in London.

def.hr: Fortificirano vino s Madeire — namjerno oksidativno i toplinsko starenje.
def.en: Fortified wine from Madeira — deliberately oxidative and heat-aged.

body.hr:
Madeira je gotovo neuništiva i kompleksna — karamel, acid, nuts. Uz cigaru izvanredna za zimski stol i punu ligu.

Sercial je sušći; Malmsey slatkiji — prilagodite cigari.
body.en:
Madeira is near-indestructible and complex — caramel, acid, nuts. With cigars excellent for winter tables and full ligero.

Sercial is drier; Malmsey sweeter — match to the cigar.

def.hr: Tamno fermentirani omotač, obično slatkiji i puniji nego svjetliji listovi.
def.en: Dark fermented wrapper, usually sweeter and fuller than lighter leaves.

body.hr:
Maduro nije sorta duhana — to je stupanj fermentacije i boje. Tamniji list, duže fermentiran, često s karameliziranim notama.

Ne znači automatski „jače” — slatkoća može maskirati ligero. Degustirajte, ne pretpostavljajte.

Na stolu maduro je okusna oznaka, ne mjera snage.
body.en:
Maduro is not a tobacco varietal — it is a level of fermentation and colour. Darker leaf, longer fermented, often with caramelised notes.

It does not automatically mean stronger — sweetness can soften ligero. Taste, do not assume.

At the table maduro is a flavour label, not a strength gauge.

def.hr: Receptura zrnja (kukuruz, ječam, raž, pšenica) prije fermentacije whiskeyja.
def.en: The grain recipe (corn, barley, rye, wheat) before whiskey fermentation.

body.hr:
Mash bill određuje slatkoću vs začin. Bourbon (>51 % kukuruz) vs rye (>51 % raž) daje različit cigara most.

Nije obavezno na etiketi, ali educira izbor.
body.en:
Mash bill sets sweetness vs spice. Bourbon (>51% corn) vs rye (>51% rye) gives different cigar bridges.

Not always on the label, but it guides choice.

def.hr: Lokalizirano mekše punjenje u tijelu cigare.
def.en: Localized softer filler areas in the cigar body.

body.hr:
Meka mjesta osjetite pritiskom duž tijela — praznina ili labaviji list u punjenju. Mogu uzrokovati neravno gorenje ili labav draw u tom dijelu.

Pri kupnji lagano pritisnite cigaru; meka mjesta su razlog za zamjenu, ne za popust bez razgovora.
body.en:
Soft spots are felt by gently squeezing the body — a gap or loose leaf in the bunch. They may cause uneven burn or loose draw in that section.

When buying, lightly press along the cigar; soft spots warrant exchange, not silent discount.

def.hr: Klasični plamen upaljača ili svijeće bez turbo mlaznice.
def.en: Classic lighter or candle flame without a jet nozzle.

body.hr:
Meki plamen pali cigaru nježnije i mirisnije — cedar spill ili plamen upaljača blizu foota daje kontrolu pri toastingu. Manje agresivan je prema opni.

Vanjski vjetar otežava uporabu; turbo je praktičniji na terasi, meki plamen elegantniji u salonu.
body.en:
A soft flame lights more gently and aromatically — cedar spill or lighter flame near the foot gives control when toasting. Less aggressive to the wrapper.

Outdoor wind hampers use; torch is practical on the terrace, soft flame more elegant indoors.

def.hr: U aplikaciji: raspon ocjena u kojem motor predlaže sparivanje, a ne jamči ga.
def.en: In the app: a score range where the engine suggests a pairing, without guaranteeing it.

body.hr: Meki pojas znači da postotak nije sud na stolu — to je smjer za istraživanje. Ispod njega piće i dalje može odgovarati vašem ukusu; iznad njega nije obećanje savršenstva. Stol uvijek ima prednost pred algoritmom.
body.en: A soft band means the percentage is not a verdict at the table — it is a direction for exploration. Below it, a drink may still suit your taste; above it is not a promise of perfection. The table always outweighs the algorithm.

def.hr: Rum destiliran iz melase — klasičan stil većine karipskih i latinoameričkih ruma.
def.en: Rum distilled from molasses — the classic style of most Caribbean and Latin American rums.

body.hr:
Melasa daje karamelu, suho voće i toplinu koja se prirodno slaže uz dim i cedar u cigarama. Od blanco viskova do dugo starenih — spektar je ogroman.

Razlikujte stvarno starenje od bojenih „gold” rumova bez navoda o godinama u bačvi.
body.en:
Molasses brings caramel, dried fruit and warmth that align with smoke and cedar in cigars. From white sips to long-aged bottlings, the spectrum is vast.

Distinguish genuine aging from coloured «gold» rums with no stated time in cask.

def.hr: Destilat agave iz Meksika — širi od tequile; često dimni, artisan karakter.
def.en: Agave distillate from Mexico — broader than tequila; often smoky, artisan character.

body.hr: Mezcal je šira obitelj agave destilata; tequila je zaštićeni podskup (plava Weber agave, određene meksičke države). Dim često dolazi iz pečenja agave u zemljanim jamama — zato može parirati punoj, zemljanoj cigari kao peated whisky.\n\nTradicionalno se pije neat, gutljajem, sobne temperature, s vodom sa strane — ne kao shot. Etiketa „worm” je turistički mit, ne kvaliteta.
body.en: Mezcal is the broader agave-spirit family; tequila is a protected subset (Weber blue agave, specified Mexican states). Smoke often comes from roasting agave in earthen pits — hence it can pair with full earthy cigars like peated whisky.\n\nTraditionally drunk neat, sipped at room temperature, with water on the side — not as a shot. The «worm» label is tourist myth, not quality.

def.hr: Miris dima koji ostaje oko pušača.
def.en: The aroma of smoke left around the smoker.

body.hr:
Room note razlikuje se od okusa u ustima — gleda kako miris djeluje u prostoru. Slatki, cvjetni, drveni ili začinski tonovi mogu biti privlačni netkoima koji ne puše.

Pri društvenom pušenju room note je dio pristojnosti: jak miris u zatvorenom prostoru traži ventilaciju ili pauzu vani.
body.en:
Room note differs from mouth flavor — how the aroma behaves in space. Sweet, floral, woody, or spicy tones may appeal even to non-smokers.

In social smoking, room note is part of courtesy: heavy scent indoors calls for ventilation or a break outside.

def.hr: Piće koje povezuje okus cigare i sljedeći gutljaj bez da dominira stolom.
def.en: A drink that links the cigar and the next sip without dominating the table.

body.hr: Most nije najjače piće večeri niti najslabije — to je srednji ton koji drži razgovor između dima i čaše. Dobro radi kad želite premostiti prelaz s aperitiva na glavni dio večeri ili s lagane cigare na punije piće. Ako most postane glavni glumac, gubite ritam stola.
body.en: A bridge is neither the boldest nor the weakest pour of the evening — it is the middle voice between smoke and glass. It works when you want to move from an aperitif into the main part of the night, or from a lighter cigar toward a fuller drink. When the bridge steals the scene, the table loses its rhythm.

def.hr: Traka koja ne prati gorenje i ostaje netaknuta.
def.en: A band that does not burn and remains untouched.

body.hr:
Mrtva traka (band) ostaje intact dok opna oko nje gori — neke marke koriste deblji papir ili foliju. Traku uklonite prije nego plamen stigne do nje kako ne bi okusila dim ili zapalila papir.

Lagano zavlažite i skinite; ne trgajte opnu.
body.en:
A dead band stays intact while wrapper around it burns — some brands use thicker paper or foil. Remove the band before flame reaches it so it does not scent smoke or ignite paper.

Moisten lightly and slide off; do not tear wrapper.

def.hr: Piće servirano preko leda — hladnije, blaže, razblaženije s vremenom.
def.en: Spirit served over ice — cooler, milder, diluting over time.

body.hr:
Led smanjuje percipiranu jačinu alkohola — korisno uz cigaru toplini ili s visokim ABV. Single large cube razblažuje sporije od sitnog leda.

Whisky puristi preferiraju neat + kap vode umjesto leda.
body.en:
Ice lowers perceived alcohol strength — useful with cigars in heat or high ABV. One large cube dilutes slower than crushed ice.

Whisky purists prefer neat + water drop over ice.

def.hr: Duhana uzgajana na punom suncu, deblji list, puniji okus.
def.en: Tobacco grown in full sun, thicker leaf, fuller flavour.

body.hr:
Sun-grown duhana dobiva više UV i topline — list je deblji, jači, više oleozan. Omotač je često tamniji i okus izraženiji.

Corojo, broadleaf i mnogi habano omotači sun-grown su. Jačina i dalje ovisi o blendu.

Kad omotač izgleda „rustično”, često je sun-grown.
body.en:
Sun-grown tobacco gets more UV and heat — leaf is thicker, stronger, more oily. Wrapper is often darker and flavour bolder.

Corojo, broadleaf, and many habano wrappers are sun-grown. Strength still depends on blend.

When wrapper looks rustic, it is often sun-grown.

def.hr: Pomorska konvencija: alkoholna jačina oko 57 % ABV — danas i za gin i rum.
def.en: Naval convention: alcohol around 57% ABV — today used for gin and rum alike.

body.hr:
Pri oko 57 % ABV neke arome ostaju bolje otvorene nego pri 40 %. Uz cigaru navy-strength gin u suhom G&T-u ili rum s kapljom vode otvara slojeve bez slatkoće.

Stil, ne rang kvalitete.
body.en:
At ~57% ABV some aromatics stay better suspended than at 40%. For cigar pairing, navy-strength gin in a dry G&T or rum with a water splash opens layers without sweetness.

A style choice, not a quality rank.

def.hr: Piće iz boce u čašu — bez leda, bez vode, bez mixera.
def.en: Spirit poured from bottle to glass — no ice, no water, no mixer.

body.hr:
Neat je default za ozbiljan cigarski stol: cognac, rum, whisky. Alkohol može „peći” — mali gutljaji, rotacija s dimom.

Cask strength neat uz vodu je varijanta — vidi water-splash.
body.en:
Neat is the default for a serious cigar table: cognac, rum, whisky. Alcohol may «burn» — small sips, rotation with smoke.

Cask strength neat with water is a variant — see water-splash.

def.hr: Koktel gin + Campari + sweet vermouth — gorak, sladak, crven.
def.en: Cocktail of gin + Campari + sweet vermouth — bitter, sweet, red.

body.hr:
Negroni je amaro-adjacent partner uz srednje do pune cigare — gorčina paralelna je s ligero. Previše slatko u vermouthu može naglasiti maduro previše.

Equal parts je klasičan recept; ne „pravilo zakona”.
body.en:
Negroni is an amaro-adjacent partner with medium-full cigars — bitterness parallels ligero. Too much vermouth sweetness can over-highlight maduro.

Equal parts is the classic recipe; not a «law».

def.hr: Omotač iz Nikaragve, često pun, pikantan i zemljan.
def.en: Wrapper from Nicaragua, often full, spicy, and earthy.

body.hr:
Nikaragva daje sun-grown omotače s karakterom — paprika, cacao, zemlja. Estetika je grublja nego ekvadorska, okus izraženiji.

Često u punim blendovima gdje omotač sudjeluje u jačini. Jalapa i Estelí imaju različite reputacije.

Kad blend „udara”, provjerite je li omotač iz Nikaragve.
body.en:
Nicaragua produces sun-grown wrappers with character — pepper, cocoa, earth. Look is rougher than Ecuadorian, flavour bolder.

Often in full blends where wrapper joins strength. Jalapa and Estelí carry different reputations.

When a blend punches, check if wrapper is Nicaraguan.

def.hr: Centralnoamerička sila u punim mješavina.
def.en: Central American powerhouse in full-bodied blends.

body.hr:
Nikaragva danas simbolizira puno tijelo, začine i koncentraciju — Estelí, Jalapa, Condega, Ometepe. Mnoge marke ovdje grade tvornice i plantaže.

Za stol: nikaragvanska najava često znači više snage nego klasična dominikanska.
body.en:
Nicaragua today symbolizes full body, spice, and concentration — Estelí, Jalapa, Condega, Ometepe. Many brands build factories and farms here.

At the table, Nicaraguan often means more strength than classic Dominican.

def.hr: Prekomjerna reakcija na nikotin tijekom pušenja.
def.en: Excessive nicotine reaction while smoking.

body.hr:
Nikotinska mučnina (nic-sick) javlja se kao vrtoglavica, mučnina, hladan znoj — često kod jakih cigaru na prazan želudac ili uz prebrzo pušenje.

Usporite, jedite nešto blago, pijte vodu; jaču cigaru odložite. Nema srama u prekidu — tijelo postavlja granicu.
body.en:
Nic-sickness shows as dizziness, nausea, cold sweat — often from strong cigars on an empty stomach or fast pacing.

Slow down, eat something mild, drink water; defer the stronger cigar. No shame in stopping — the body sets the limit.

def.hr: Pojedinačni miris ili okus koji prepoznajete u dimu ili piću — gradivni element razgovora.
def.en: A single aroma or taste you recognize in smoke or drink — a building block of table talk.

body.hr: Note su riječi stola: cedar, kakao, citrus, dim. Ne moraju biti „točne” kao laboratorij; moraju biti zajedničke. Kad gost kaže „osjećam orahe”, to je most prema piću, ne ispit iz enologije.
body.en: Notes are the table's vocabulary: cedar, cocoa, citrus, smoke. They need not be laboratory-precise; they must be shared. When a guest says "I get nuts," that is a bridge to the drink, not an exam in oenology.

def.hr: Kratki ostatak cigare nakon pušenja.
def.en: The short remainder of a cigar after smoking.

body.hr:
Nub je nepušeni ili djelomično pušeni kraj — obično se smatra pristojnim ostaviti barem dva prsta neizgorenog lišća, iako neki puše do samog capa.

Ne miješati s plug u punjenju: nub je ostatak nakon dima, plug je konstrukcijski problem unutra.
body.en:
The nub is the unsmoked or partly smoked end — etiquette often leaves at least two fingers unburned, though some smoke to the cap.

Do not confuse with filler plug: nub is post-smoke remnant, plug is an internal construction issue.

def.hr: Skup srodnih nota koje se obično spominju zajedno — orašasto, biljno, dimno, slatko.
def.en: A cluster of related notes usually named together — nutty, herbal, smoky, sweet.

body.hr: Obitelj je praktičniji od popisa deset pojedinačnih nota. „Dimno-biljno” govori više od tri odvojene riječi koje nitko ne pamti. Pri sparivanju prvo tražite obitelj, pa tek onda finu razliku unutar nje.
body.en: A family is more practical than a list of ten isolated notes. "Smoky-herbal" says more than three separate words nobody will remember. When pairing, look for the family first, then the fine difference within it.

def.hr: Brojčani nagovještaj u aplikaciji — koliko dim i piće dijele zajedničke parametre.
def.en: A numeric hint in the app — how much smoke and drink share common parameters.

body.hr: Ocjena je alat, ne presuda. Dva pića s istim postotkom mogu dati različit doživljaj ovisno o večeri, hrani i vašem ritmu. Koristite je kao kratki popis za razgovor, ne kao konačnu istinu.
body.en: The score is a tool, not a verdict. Two drinks at the same percentage can feel different depending on the meal, the pace, and your mood. Use it as a shortlist for conversation, not as final truth.

note.hr: Visoka ocjena nije ista stvar kao stvarna harmonija za vaš stol.
note.en: A high score is not the same as real harmony at your table.

def.hr: Oksidativno staren sherry bez flor — pun, orašast, bez dodanog šećera u klasičnom stilu.
def.en: Oxidatively aged sherry without flor — full, nutty, no added sugar in classic style.

body.hr:
Oloroso voli punu cigaru i večernji stol. Tanini i orasi idu uz maduro i habano dim.

Cream sherry je slatka mješavina — drugačiji profil sparivanja.
body.en:
Oloroso loves full cigars and evening tables. Tannins and nuts parallel maduro and habano smoke.

Cream sherry is a sweet blend — different pairing profile.

def.hr: Nikaragvansko ostrvo s vulkanskim tlima za duhan.
def.en: Nicaraguan island with volcanic tobacco soil.

body.hr:
Ometepe u jezeru Nicaragua daje lišće s mineralnim, ponekad slanim naglasima zbog vulkanskog tla. Rjeđe je od matičnih regija, ali prepoznatljivo u mješavina koje traže karakter.

Za degustaciju: tražite zemljaste i specijske note u srednjoj trećini.
body.en:
Ometepe in Lake Nicaragua produces leaf with mineral, sometimes salty accents from volcanic soil. Rarer than mainland regions, but distinctive in character-driven blends.

For tasting: seek earthy, savory notes in the middle third.

def.hr: Vanjski list duhana koji oblikuje izgled, aromu i prvi dojam pri pušenju.
def.en: The outermost tobacco leaf that shapes appearance, aroma, and first impression when smoking.

body.hr:
Omotač je prvo što primijetite na stolu: boja, sjaj i fina tekstura. U okusu nosi najnježnije note — kremasto, slatko, začinsko — jer je list tanak i pažljivo biran.

Kvaliteta omotača utječe na gustoću dima i ravnotežu, ali sama po sebi ne određuje jačinu. Dobar omotač dopušta punjenju da se čuje, umjesto da ga prekrije.

Kod usporedbe dviju cigara iste veličine korisno je spomenuti omotač — često objašnjava razliku u karakteru.
body.en:
The wrapper is the first thing you notice at the table: colour, sheen, and fine texture. In flavour it carries the gentlest notes — cream, sweetness, spice — because the leaf is thin and carefully chosen.

Wrapper quality affects smoke density and balance, but does not by itself define strength. A good wrapper lets the filler speak rather than masking it.

When comparing two cigars of the same size, naming the wrapper often explains the difference in character.

def.hr: Visokoalkoholna boca traži manje u čaši i više pažnje uz dim.
def.en: High-proof bottles ask for less in the glass and more care beside smoke.

body.hr: Overproof piće udvostručuje i alkohol i aromu; dim već zauzima nepce. Jedan mali gutljaj može biti most; puna čaša često prekida večer prije treće trećine. Domaćin neka ponudi vodu bez komentara.
body.en: Overproof doubles both alcohol and aroma; smoke already occupies the palate. One small sip can bridge; a full glass often ends the evening before the final third. The host should offer water without comment.

def.hr: Nefermentirani šećer u vinu nakon fermentacije — slatkoća u okusu.
def.en: Unfermented sugar left after fermentation — perceived sweetness.

body.hr:
Slatko vino ili port uz cigaru traži pažnju: slatkoća može naglasiti slatkoću maduro ili sukobiti sa suhom ligom.

PX sherry ekstrem je — vidi sherry-px.
body.en:
Sweet wine or port with cigars needs care: sweetness can highlight maduro or clash with dry ligero.

PX sherry is the extreme — see sherry-px.

def.hr: Opna se odvaja od punjenja tijekom dima.
def.en: Wrapper separating from the filler during the smoke.

body.hr:
Otpadanje opne obično počinje blizu capa ili na mjestu oštećenja — loš rez, suho skladištenje ili konstrukcijski kvar. Spriječite daljnje klizanje vlažnom kapicom bez ljepila u javnosti.

Profesionalci ponekad koriste pectin; kućna uporaba treba biti diskretna.
body.en:
Unraveling usually starts near the cap or at damage — bad cut, dry storage, or construction flaw. Halt further slip with a damp cap touch without public glue drama.

Pros sometimes use pectin; home repair should stay discreet.

def.hr: Stopa bez prekrivanja omotačem, punjenje je vidljivo i lakše se pali.
def.en: Foot without wrapper cover, filler visible and easier to light.

body.hr:
Otvorena stopa je najčešći format. Punjenje je vidljivo — ponekad i estetski namjerno izloženo.

Paljenje je jednostavnije, prvi dim dolazi brže. Nema posebnog „teatralnog” početka kao kod zatvorene stope.

Za svakodnevno pušenje to je standard; zatvorena stopa je stilski izbor, ne nužno kvaliteta.
body.en:
An open foot is the most common format. Filler is visible — sometimes deliberately exposed for looks.

Lighting is straightforward; first draw comes quickly. No special theatrical opening like a closed foot.

For everyday smoking this is standard; closed foot is a stylistic choice, not necessarily quality.

def.hr: Rum s ABV-om znatno iznad standardnih ~40 % — često 57 % ili više.
def.en: Rum with ABV well above the usual ~40% — often 57% or higher.

body.hr:
Overproof nije „jači okus”, nego koncentriran alkohol i aroma. Uz cigaru predlažemo razblaženje ili vrlo mali gutljaj.

U koktelu highball ili daiquiri s ledom smanjuju udar; aplikacija voli umjerenije ABV-e.
body.en:
Overproof is not simply «more flavour» but concentrated alcohol and aroma. At the table with a cigar, dilution or a very small sip is wise.

In cocktails, highball or daiquiri with ice tame the punch; the pairing app favours moderate ABV.

def.hr: U katalogu: oznaka da boca ulazi u sparivanje s cigarom, a ne samo na popis za kupnju.
def.en: In the catalog: a mark that a bottle enters cigar pairing, not the shopping list alone.

body.hr: Ne ide svaka boca s police uz cigaru. Oznaka sparivosti izdvaja boce koje ulaze u sparivanje s dimom i štedi gosta od kremastih likera te RTD-a — gotovih miješanih pića u limenci ili boci (eng. ready-to-drink), često slatkih i napravljenih za zabavu, ne za večer uz dim. To je odluka kataloga, ne zabrana.
body.en: Not every bottle from the shelf belongs with a cigar. The pairable mark picks bottles that enter pairing with smoke and spares guests creamy liqueurs and RTDs — ready-to-drink mixed drinks in a can or bottle, often sweet and made for fun, not for an evening with smoke. It is a catalog choice, not a ban.

def.hr: Pepeo koji se lako raspada u pahuljice.
def.en: Ash that crumbles easily into flakes.

body.hr:
Pahuljasti pepeo ne drži čvrsto oblik i rasipa se pri tapkanju. Može značiti labavije punjenje, neravnomjerno gorenje ili previsoku relativnu vlagu pri pušenju.

Nije nužno greška pušača, ali obično prati manje elegantno iskustvo nego pepeo koji drži konus.
body.en:
Flaky ash will not hold shape and scatters when tapped. It may indicate loose filler, uneven burn, or overly high humidity while smoking.

Not always the smoker's fault, but it usually accompanies a less elegant experience than a firm conical stack.

def.hr: Cilindrična cigaru s ravnim tijelom od glave do stope.
def.en: A cylindrical cigar with straight sides from head to foot.

body.hr:
Parejo je „klasična” silueta — ravne strane, jednak promjer. Većina svakodnevnih vitola (corona, robusto, toro) parejo je.

Lakše se drži, reže i skladišti nego figurado. Gorenje je obično predvidivije.

Kad netko kaže „normalna cigaru”, često misli na parejo.
body.en:
Parejo is the classic silhouette — straight sides, even diameter. Most everyday vitolas (corona, robusto, toro) are parejos.

Easier to hold, cut, and store than figurados. Burn is usually more predictable.

When someone says a normal cigar, they often mean parejo.

def.hr: Kubanska regija poznata po jakom vezivu i punjenju.
def.en: Cuban region known for strong binder and filler.

body.hr:
Partido unutar šireg kubanskog pojasa daje čvrsto lišće koje se cijeni u mješavini za strukturu. Manje je simboličan od Vuelta Abaja u marketingu, ali stručnjaci ga prate.

Korisno ime kad se raspravlja o kubanskom tijelu bez mitologije.
body.en:
Partido within the wider Cuban belt yields firm leaf prized in blends for structure. Less symbolic than Vuelta Abajo in marketing, but tracked by specialists.

Useful when discussing Cuban body without mythology.

def.hr: Održavanje vlage bez ventilatora ili uređaja.
def.en: Maintaining moisture without fans or powered devices.

body.hr:
Pasivna humidifikacija oslanja se na spužvu, kristale, gel ili Boveda u zatvorenom prostoru. Jednostavna je i tiha — idealna za kućni humidor.

Ključ je ravnoteža: premalo vode suši, previše tura. Redovito punjenje i kalibrirani higrometar drže stvari predvidivima.
body.en:
Passive humidification relies on sponges, crystals, gel, or Boveda in a sealed space. Simple and silent — ideal for home humidors.

Balance is key: too little water dries, too much muddies. Regular refills and a calibrated hygrometer keep things predictable.

def.hr: Francuski anis liker razblažen vodom — louche efekt, sladak, biljni.
def.en: French anise liqueur diluted with water — louche effect, sweet, herbal.

body.hr:
Pastis uz cigaru je mediteranski aperitiv/digestif rub — anis voli začinske note u cigari. Razblaženje vodom smanjuje ABV i slatkoću percipiranje.

Pernod i Ricard su poznati brandovi; absinthe je drugačija kategorija.
body.en:
Pastis with cigars is a Mediterranean aperitif/digestif edge — anise loves spice notes in cigars. Water dilution lowers ABV and perceived sweetness.

Pernod and Ricard are known brands; absinthe is a different category.

def.hr: Whisky s dimom iz sušenja ječma nad trstikom — karakterističan za dio Škotske.
def.en: Whisky with smoke from drying malt over peat — characteristic of parts of Scotland.

body.hr:
Treset i dim cigare mogu biti savršen par ili previše dima. Pravilo stola: usporedite intenzitet — lagani peat uz srednje cigare, teški Islay uz punu ligu.

Peat se mjeri u ppm fenola; visok ppm nije uvijek „bolji”.
body.en:
Peat and cigar smoke can be a perfect match or too much smoke. Table rule: match intensity — light peat with medium cigars, heavy Islay with full ligero.

Peat is measured in ppm phenol; high ppm is not always «better».

def.hr: Izuzetno slatki sherry od grožđa PX — sirup, suho voće, karamela.
def.en: Very sweet sherry from PX grapes — syrup, dried fruit, caramel.

body.hr:
PX je desert uz cigaru, ne uz prvi dim. Radi s najslađim maduro i nakon jela.

Mala količina — slatkoća dominira.
body.en:
PX is dessert with a cigar, not first smoke. Works with the sweetest maduro after a meal.

Small pours — sweetness dominates.

def.hr: Balkanski pelin liker — gorak, biljni, često lokalni brand (Aura i sl.).
def.en: Balkan wormwood liqueur — bitter, herbal, often local brands (Aura etc.).

body.hr:
Pelinkovac uz cigaru je regionalni stol — gorčina i bilje uz earth i pepper u cigari. Ledeni servis smanjuje oštrinu.

Ne miješajte s absintom — drugačija tradicija i ABV.
body.en:
Pelinkovac with cigars is a regional table — bitterness and herbs with earth and pepper in the cigar. Iced service lowers sharpness.

Do not confuse with absinthe — different tradition and ABV.

def.hr: Posuda za pepeo i kratke pauze cigare.
def.en: A vessel for ash and brief cigar rests.

body.hr:
Pepeljara treba imati dovoljno široko ležište za cigaru u u odmoru — uska lokalna pepeljara prisiljava na neugodan kut. Duboki kanali drže pepeo bez rasipanja.

Ne koristite pepeljaru kao peć za gasiti cigaru; rez i poštovan prema dimu.
body.en:
An ashtray needs a wide enough rest for a cigar on pause — narrow local ashtrays force awkward angles. Deep channels hold ash without scatter.

Do not use the ashtray as a furnace to crush out a cigar; cut and respect the smoke.

def.hr: Mineralni ostatak gorenja punjenja i veziva.
def.en: The mineral residue left as filler and binder burn.

body.hr:
Pepeo na cigari nije prljavština nego strukturirani trag gorenja. Dobar pepeo drži oblik neko vrijeme, a boja i tekstura daju naznake o gnojivu, vlagi i kvaliteti lišća.

Ne treba ga nasilno otkidati; pustite da padne sam ili lagano tapnite. Dugačak pepeo može značiti hladnije gorenje — ponekad.
body.en:
Ash on a cigar is not dirt but a structured trace of combustion. Good ash holds shape for a while; color and texture hint at soil, moisture, and leaf quality.

Do not knock it off aggressively; let it fall or tap lightly. A long ash can mean cooler burning — sometimes.

def.hr: Gomila listova tijekom fermentacije, okretana da se kontrolira temperatura.
def.en: Pile of leaves during fermentation, turned to control temperature.

body.hr:
Pilón — burro na kubanskom — je srce fermentacije. Listovi se slažu, zagrijavaju, okreću u ciklusima dok amoniak ne ode, a okus ne sazri.

Veličina pilóna i vještina majstora određuju kvalitetu. Prebrzo = sirovo; predugo = izgubljene nijanse.

Na stolu rijetko se spominje, ali objašnjava zašto fermentacija nije „samo čekanje”.
body.en:
Pilón — burro in Cuban Spanish — is the heart of fermentation. Leaves stack, heat, turn in cycles until ammonia leaves and flavour matures.

Pile size and master skill set quality. Too fast = raw; too long = lost nuance.

Rarely mentioned at the table, but explains why fermentation is not just waiting.

def.hr: Zapadna kubanska provincija duhanskog uzgoja.
def.en: Western Cuban province of tobacco cultivation.

body.hr:
Pinar del Río obuhvaća Vuelta Abajo i srodne podregije — ime se koristi i šire od samog appellationa. Klima i tlo ovdje oblikuju finu opnu i punjenje habanosa.

Na etiketi provincija naglašava podrijetlo, ne kvalitetu same po sebi.
body.en:
Pinar del Río encompasses Vuelta Abajo and related subregions — the name is used broader than the appellation alone. Climate and soil here shape fine habano wrapper and filler.

On labels, the province stresses origin, not quality by itself.

def.hr: Figurado koji se kontinuirano sužava od široke stope prema zašiljenoj glavi.
def.en: A figurado that continuously tapers from a wide foot to a pointed head.

body.hr:
Piramida mijenja promjer cijelim dimom — okus se zgušnjava prema glavi. Stopa je široka, pa paljenje je obično jednostavno.

Traži pažniju konstrukciju nego parejo. Ritam pušenja treba pratiti promjenu profila.

Korisno ime kad objašnjavate zašto zadnja trećina „pojačava”.
body.en:
Pyramid changes diameter through the smoke — flavour thickens toward the head. Foot is wide, so lighting is usually easy.

It needs more careful construction than parejo. Smoking rhythm should follow the shifting profile.

Useful when explaining why the final third intensifies.

def.hr: Plavi ili plavi-sivi gljivični nalaz na lišću.
def.en: Blue or blue-gray fungal spotting on leaf.

body.hr:
Plava plijesen u skladištu obično znači previsoku vlagu, lošu cirkulaciju zraka ili kontaminiran humidor. Na opni izgleda kao plavi prah ili mrlje.

Prevencija: RH oko 65–70 %, redovito provjetravanje i čiste drvene površine. Nakon infekcije, cedar i zalihe trebaju temeljitu obnovu.
body.en:
Blue mold in storage usually means excess humidity, poor air circulation, or a contaminated humidor. On the wrapper it looks like blue dust or spots.

Prevention: RH around 65–70%, regular airing, and clean wood surfaces. After infection, cedar and contents need thorough renewal.

def.hr: Uvitak omotača na glavi umjesto ravne kapice, dekorativan i funkcionalan zatvarač.
def.en: A twisted tail of wrapper at the head instead of a flat cap, decorative and functional.

body.hr:
Pigtail je mali uvijeni vrh — ne reže se kao klasična kapica; često se samo malo otvori ili odgurne. Daje cigaru prepoznatljiv izgled.

Zahtijeva pažnju pri paljenju i prvom povlačenju dima. Nije čest na svakodnevnim vitolama, ali se pojavlju u limitiranim serijama.

Na stolu je razgovor o tradiciji završnog rada, ne o boljem okusu sam po sebi.
body.en:
A pigtail is a small twisted tip — not cut like a classic cap; often slightly opened or nudged aside. It gives a distinctive look.

It needs care when lighting and on the first draws. Uncommon on everyday vitolas but appears in limited lines.

At the table it is talk about finishing tradition, not better flavour by itself.

def.hr: Živahni gljivični rast na opni ili u humidoru.
def.en: Living fungal growth on the wrapper or in the humidor.

body.hr:
Plijesen izgleda kao plavkaste, zelenkaste ili bijele dlake koje se šire i vraćaju nakon brisanja. Za razliku od plumea, plijesen je vlažna i strukturirana.

Zahvaćene cigare izolirajte; očistite humidor i provjerite RH. Blaga površinska plijesen ponekad se može pažljivo ukloniti, ali sumnjive primjerke bolje izbaciti.
body.en:
Mold appears as blue, green, or white fuzz that spreads and returns after wiping. Unlike plume, mold feels moist and structured.

Isolate affected cigars; clean the humidor and check RH. Light surface mold can sometimes be carefully removed, but discard doubtful sticks.

def.hr: Gusti snop lišća unutar punjenja, ne nub.
def.en: A dense wad of leaf inside the filler, not the nub.

body.hr:
Plug u punjenju označava lokalno zbijeno lišće u bunchu — može dati usko povlačenje bez da je cijela cigaru loše zamotana. Ne miješati s nubom (ostatkom nakon pušenja) niti s plugged cigara kao cjelinom.

Termin je tehnički; za stol dovoljno reći da je draw usko u tom dimu.
body.en:
A tobacco plug is locally compressed leaf in the bunch — it may tighten draw without the whole cigar being poorly rolled. Do not confuse with the nub (smoked remnant) or plugged cigar as a whole.

The term is technical; at the table, saying the draw is tight in that smoke suffices.

def.hr: Gin sa zaštićenom geografskom oznakom — smije se proizvoditi samo u Plymouthu (UK).
def.en: Gin with protected geographical indication — may be produced only in Plymouth (UK).

body.hr:
Plymouth je zaseban stil od London Drya: malo manje suh, aromatičniji, sa „zemljanijim” korijenjem u botanici. Klasična jačina oko 41,2 %; navy strength (oko 57 %) povijesno je vezan uz mornaricu.

U katalogu stil „plymouth” — uz cigaru često blago mekši od oštrog London Drya bogatog borovicom.
body.en: Plymouth is a distinct style from London Dry: slightly less dry, more aromatic, with earthier roots in the botanicals. Classic strength ~41.2%; navy strength (~57%) is historically tied to the navy.\n\nIn the app catalog as style «plymouth» — for pairing often a touch softer than sharp juniper-forward London Dry.

def.hr: Kad punoća dima i pića stoje u istom registru, bez da jedno guši drugo.
def.en: When the weight of smoke and drink sit in the same register without one muffling the other.

body.hr: Podudaranje tijela znači da lagana Connecticut ne traži teški Islay, a puni maduro ne traži vodu u čaši. Stol ne mora biti simetričan do zadnjeg detalja, ali razlika u punoći ne smije biti slučajna. Ako piće nestane u dimu, tijelo ne odgovara.
body.en: Body match means a light Connecticut is not asking for a heavy Islay, and a full maduro is not served with water in the glass. The table need not be perfectly symmetrical, but the gap in weight should not be accidental. If the drink vanishes inside the smoke, the bodies do not align.

note.hr: Tijelo je punoća u ustima; jačina alkohola je zaseban sloj.
note.en: Body is weight on the palate; alcohol strength is a separate layer.

def.hr: Paljenje cigare nakon što je ugasla.
def.en: Lighting a cigar after it has gone out.

body.hr:
Ponovno paljenje je dopušteno — cigara nije svijeća koja mora gorjeti neprekidno. Uklonite pepeo, tostirajte foot, nastavite. Okus može postati nešto oštriji nakon duge pauze.

Ako je cigara ugasio u zadnjoj trećini, razmislite o završetku; ponovno paljenje tamo često donosi gorčinu.
body.en:
Relighting is acceptable — a cigar is not a candle that must burn continuously. Knock ash, toast the foot, continue. Flavor may turn slightly sharper after a long pause.

If it died in the final third, consider ending; relight there often brings bitterness.

def.hr: Fortificirano vino iz Douroa — ruby, tawny, LBV, vintage i sl.
def.en: Fortified wine from the Douro — ruby, tawny, LBV, vintage and more.

body.hr: Porto se fortificira usred fermentacije: dodani weingeist zaustavi kvasce i sačuva prirodni šećer — zato je sladak i alkoholno jak. Ruby čuva voće; tawny oksidativno stari u malim bačvama (orah, karamela).\n\nTradicionalni partner punih cigare. Vintage za posebne prilike; LBV pristupačniji. Vidi i fortificirano vino (razlika od sherryja).
body.en: Port is fortified mid-fermentation: added grape spirit stops the yeast and preserves natural sugar — hence sweet and high in alcohol. Ruby keeps fruit; tawny ages oxidatively in small casks (walnut, caramel).\n\nA traditional partner for full cigars. Vintage for occasions; LBV more approachable. See also fortified wine (contrast with sherry).

def.hr: Klasični kazan destilator — masivniji, aromatičniji destilat od column stilla.
def.en: Classic batch pot still — heavier, more aromatic spirit than column still.

body.hr:
Pot still whiskey (irski single pot still, malt) nosi tijelo koje voli punu cigaru. Column still daje čistiju, neutralniju bazu za blend.

Način destilacije oblikuje sparivanje više nego godina na etiketi u jeftinijim segmentima.
body.en:
Pot still whiskey (Irish single pot still, malt) carries body that loves a full cigar. Column still gives cleaner neutral base for blends.

Still type shapes pairing more than label age in cheaper segments.

def.hr: Otpor i protok zraka kroz dimljenu cigaru.
def.en: The resistance and airflow through a lit cigar.

body.hr:
Povlačenje (draw) opisuje koliko lako dim prolazi kroz punjenje. Uravnoteženo povlačenje dopušta glatko pušenje bez napora i bez prekomjernog zagrijavanja.

Previše usko povlačenje guši dim; previše labavo gubi temperaturu i okus. Procjena počinje hladnim povlačenjem prije paljenja.
body.en:
Draw describes how easily smoke passes through the filler. A balanced draw allows smooth smoking without effort or excessive heat.

Too tight a draw chokes the smoke; too loose a draw loses temperature and flavor. Assessment begins with a cold draw before lighting.

def.hr: Stanje skladištenja ispod željenog RH.
def.en: Storage condition below desired RH.

body.hr:
Previše suhe cigare pucaju po opni, gore vruće i gube nijanse okusa. RH ispod otprilike 62 % dugoročno oštećuje zalihe.

Oporavak ide polako u humidoru s stabilnim RH — nikad naglo u vodi. Nekoliko tjedana u pravilnom okruženju vraća elastičnost.
body.en:
Underhumidified cigars crack on the wrapper, burn hot, and lose flavor nuance. RH below roughly 62% damages stock over time.

Recovery is slow in stable RH — never shock with water. Several weeks in proper conditions restore elasticity.

def.hr: Stanje skladištenja iznad željenog RH.
def.en: Storage condition above desired RH.

body.hr:
Previše vlažne cigare imaju spužvast dodir, teško pale i okus je mutan ili plijesni. RH iznad otprilike 72–74 % dugoročno je rizično.

Rješenje: privremeno otvorite humidor, smanjite izvor vlage, koristite niži Boveda paket. Pušenje dok je cigaru prenatopljena često daje tunel gorenje.
body.en:
Overhumidified cigars feel spongy, resist lighting, and taste muddy or musty. RH above roughly 72–74% is risky long term.

Fix: air the humidor briefly, reduce humidity source, use a lower Boveda pack. Smoking while soggy often yields tunneling.

def.hr: Branje listova s stabljike u više navrata, od dna prema vrhu.
def.en: Harvesting leaves from the stalk in passes, from bottom to top.

body.hr:
Priming znači da se listovi ne beru odjednom — volado prvo, zatim seco, viso, ligero. Svaka visina sazrijeva drugačije.

To omogućuje blendu različite jačine iz iste plantaže. Ligero i volado iz istog polja nisu isti list.

Na stolu priming objašnjava zašto imena poput volado i ligero nisu marketing.
body.en:
Priming means leaves are not picked at once — volado first, then seco, viso, ligero. Each height ripens differently.

That lets a blend use different strengths from one farm. Ligero and volado from one field are not the same leaf.

At the table priming explains why names like volado and ligero are not marketing.

def.hr: Brojčana mjera promjera cigare u 64-inčnim dijelovima inča; veći broj znači deblja cigaru.
def.en: Numeric measure of cigar diameter in 64ths of an inch; higher number means thicker cigar.

body.hr:
Ring gauge ne kaže ništa o duljini — samo o debljini. Robustni formati obično su između 48 i 54, lancero može biti 38, gordo 60 i više.

Deblji profil često daje hladniji, sporiji dim; tanji može koncentrirati okus, ali traži pažniju konstrukciju.

Na stolu koristite ring gauge kad uspoređujete osjećaj u ustima, ne samo ime vitole.
body.en:
Ring gauge says nothing about length — only thickness. Robust sizes are often 48–54, lancero may be 38, gordo 60 and above.

A thicker profile often gives cooler, slower smoke; a thinner one can concentrate flavour but demands careful construction.

At the table use ring gauge when comparing mouthfeel, not just vitola name.

def.hr: Američka mjera alkohola — 100 proof ≈ 50 % ABV (klasično skaliranje).
def.en: US measure of alcohol — 100 proof ≈ 50% ABV (classic scaling).

body.hr:
Proof na američkim bocama pomaže usporediti bourbon i rye. 80 proof = 40 % ABV — standard stola.

„Barrel proof” i „cask strength” često prelaze 100 proof — oprez uz cigaru.
body.en:
Proof on American bottles helps compare bourbon and rye. 80 proof = 40% ABV — table standard.

«Barrel proof» and «cask strength» often exceed 100 proof — care with cigars.

def.hr: Lagano izdisanje kroz cigaru da se oslobodi zagorjeli dim.
def.en: Gently blowing through the cigar to clear stale smoke.

body.hr:
Purging znači lagano puhanje kroz cigaru (oprezno, kratko) kako bi se istisnuo zastarjeli, vruć dim iz punjenja nakon pauze ili vrućeg gorenja. Foot ne smije zapaliti obrnutim plamenom.

Koristite rijetko; prečesto purging maskira loše tempiranje pušenja.
body.en:
Purging means gently blowing through the cigar (carefully, briefly) to push out stale, hot smoke from the filler after a pause or hot burn. The foot must not ignite from reverse flame.

Use sparingly; constant purging hides poor pacing.

def.hr: Okrugli izrez u centru capa.
def.en: A circular cut in the center of the cap.

body.hr:
Punch (bullet cut) ostavlja veći dio kape netaknut — povlačenje je često nešto užje, koncentracija okusa jača. Pogodan za jače cigare ili guste kape.

Očistite punch nakon uporabe; zaglavljena opna kvari sljedeći rez.
body.en:
A punch (bullet cut) leaves more of the cap intact — draw is often slightly tighter, flavor concentration stronger. Suited to fuller cigars or thick caps.

Clean the punch after use; jammed wrapper ruins the next cut.

def.hr: Unutarnji slojevi duhana koji nose većinu okusa, jačine i trajanja dima.
def.en: The inner layers of tobacco that carry most of the flavour, strength, and smoking duration.

body.hr:
Tripa je srce cigare. Ovdje se spajaju različite vrste listova — jači, srednji i lakši — u blend koji određuje karakter.

Jačina, punina i razvoj okusa kroz dim najčešće dolaze iz punjenja, ne iz omotača. Zato isti omotač na različitom punjenju može zvučati potpuno drukčije.

Kad degustirate, promatrajte kako se okus otvara, srednji dio i završetak — to je najčešće priča punjenja.
body.en:
The filler is the heart of the cigar. Here different leaf types — stronger, middle, and lighter — are combined into a blend that defines character.

Strength, body, and how flavour develops through the smoke usually come from the filler, not the wrapper. The same wrapper on a different filler can taste entirely different.

When tasting, notice how flavour opens, develops in the middle, and finishes — that is usually the filler speaking.

def.hr: Cigaretu čiji su omotač, vezni list i punjenje iz iste zemlje podrijetla.
def.en: Cigar whose wrapper, binder, and filler all originate from the same country.

body.hr:
Puro — posebno na Kubi — znači 100 % domaći duhan. Drugdje se termin koristi labavije, ali ideja je territorialna cjelovitost.

Ne jamči bolji okus; jamči dosljednost podrijetla. Mješoviti blendovi mogu biti jednako dobri.

Na stolu puro je geografski pojam, ne ocjena kvalitete.
body.en:
Puro — especially in Cuba — means 100% domestic tobacco. Elsewhere the term is looser, but idea is territorial wholeness.

Does not guarantee better taste; guarantees origin consistency. Mixed-origin blends can be equally good.

At the table puro is geographic, not a quality grade.

def.hr: Kompaktno kućište za cigare u pokretu.
def.en: A compact case for cigars on the move.

body.hr:
Putni humidor štiti cigare od lomljenja i sušenja na putu. Od tvrdih plastičnih tuby do kožnih futrola s Boveda paketićem — bitno je da ne stiskaju previše i da vlaga ostane umjerena.

Na kraćim putovanjima dovoljan je dobro zatvoren case s malim stabilizatorom vlage; na dužim provjerite RH po dolasku.
body.en:
A travel humidor protects cigars from crushing and drying on the road. From hard plastic tubes to leather cases with a Boveda pack — avoid over-packing and keep moisture moderate.

For short trips a well-sealed case with a small humidity stabilizer suffices; on longer ones check RH after arrival.

def.hr: Poprečni rez koji skida dio capa.
def.en: A crosscut removing part of the cap.

body.hr:
Ravni (guillotine) rez otvara širu površinu nego punch — draw je obično slobodniji, okusi se malo više otvaraju. Odrežite samo cap, ne i ramena opne.

Dvostruke oštrice daju čistiji rez; zamućene oštrice ruše cap.
body.en:
A straight (guillotine) cut opens a wider surface than a punch — draw is usually freer, flavors open a bit more. Cut only the cap, not the shoulder.

Double blades give cleaner cuts; dull blades wreck the cap.

def.hr: Rub gorenja ide paralelno duž cigare.
def.en: The burn line travels parallel along the cigar.

body.hr:
Ravnomjerno gorenje znači da se opna i punjenje pale u istom ritmu, bez naglog nagiba linije pepela. To je znak dobre konstrukcije i uravnoteženog tempa pušenja.

Ako gorenje klizi na jednu stranu, razmotrite sporije pušenje ili blagi touch-up prije nego problem postane izrazit.
body.en:
An even burn means wrapper and filler ignite at the same pace, without a sharp tilt in the ash line. It signals sound construction and balanced pacing.

If the burn drifts to one side, consider slower smoking or a gentle touch-up before the issue grows.

def.hr: Kad nijedan element večeri ne traži da se ostali ušute.
def.en: When no single element of the evening asks the others to go silent.

body.hr: Ravnoteža je tihi cilj dobrog stola. Dim smije biti glavni, ali piće mora imati glas; piće smije biti glavno, ali dim ne smije postati propast. Ako gost mora birati „ili”, ravnoteža je poremetena.
body.en: Balance is the quiet goal of a good table. Smoke may lead, but the drink must speak; the drink may lead, but smoke must not be wasted. If the guest must choose "either/or," balance is lost.

def.hr: Postotak vlage u zraku u odnosu na zasićenje.
def.en: Air moisture as a percentage of saturation.

body.hr:
Relativna vlaga (RH) određuje koliko cigare upijaju ili gube vlagu u humidoru. Za većinu habanos i premium rucnih, cilj je obično 65–72 %, ovisno o okusu i klasi lišća.

RH se mjeri higrometrom; bez mjerenja nagađate. Previsoka vlaga tura okus i potiče plijesen; preniska suši opnu.
body.en:
Relative humidity (RH) governs how cigars absorb or lose moisture in storage. For most premium hand-rolled cigars, aim is usually 65–72%, depending on taste and leaf style.

RH is read with a hygrometer; without measurement you are guessing. Too high muddies flavor and invites mold; too low dries the wrapper.

def.hr: Tequila starena u hrastu kratko (mjeseci) — balans agave i vanilije.
def.en: Tequila aged briefly in oak (months) — balance of agave and vanilla.

body.hr:
Reposado je često najbolji tequila most uz cigaru: dovoljno bačve, još agave svježine. Idealno uz medium-full s earth notom.

„Reposado” ima minimalne zakonske zahtjeve u Meksiku — provjerite brand.
body.en:
Reposado is often the best tequila bridge with cigars: enough cask, still agave freshness. Ideal with medium-full earth notes.

«Reposado» has minimum legal requirements in Mexico — check the brand.

def.hr: Propuštanje dima kroz nos radi aromatičnog dojma.
def.en: Passing smoke through the nose for aromatic assessment.

body.hr:
Retrohale (nosno izdisanje) otkriva mirise koje jezik ne hvata — začini, cvijeće, zemlja. Radi se nakon što dim kratko stoji u ustima, bez dubokog udisaja u pluća.

Ne forsirati: jače nikotinske cigare mogu iritirati. U degustaciji je alat, ne obaveza.
body.en:
Retrohale reveals aromas the palate misses — spice, florals, earth. Smoke rests briefly in the mouth, then exits through the nose without deep lung inhale.

Do not force it: stronger nicotine cigars can irritate. In tasting it is a tool, not a duty.

def.hr: Alat za otvaranje vrha cigare prije pušenja.
def.en: A tool for opening the cigar head before smoking.

body.hr:
Rezač mora biti oštar: mljeveni cap razmazuje okus i pomaže odlupiti opnu. Guillotine, punch i V-cut daju različitu površinu otvaranja i time blago mijenjaju draw i koncentraciju okusa.

Pri stolu rez je tih radnja; ne treba dramatično otvarati šampanjac.
body.en:
A cutter must be sharp: a torn cap smears flavor and invites unraveling. Guillotine, punch, and V-cut offer different opening surfaces, subtly changing draw and flavor concentration.

At the table, cutting is a quiet act — no need to pop champagne.

def.hr: Rum destiliran iz svježe šećerne trske, tipično s Martiniquea ili Guadeloupea.
def.en: Rum distilled from fresh sugarcane juice, typical of Martinique or Guadeloupe.

body.hr:
Agricole nosi biljni, travnati karakter koji se razlikuje od melasa-ruma. U pariranju s cigarama često radi bolje s medium- do punijim dimenzijama koje ne guše zelenu svježinu.

Na etiketi tražite AOC oznake kad želite autentičan stil, ne samo marketing „agrícola”.
body.en:
Agricole carries a grassy, vegetal character distinct from molasses rum. In cigar pairing it often suits medium to fuller cigars that do not overwhelm its green freshness.

Look for AOC labels when you want authentic style, not just a marketing «agricole» claim.

def.hr: Kraći „restricted” espresso — manje vode, više koncentracije i slatkoće.
def.en: Shorter «restricted» espresso — less water, more concentration and sweetness.

body.hr:
Ristretto je intenzivniji od standardnog espressa — manji volumen, jači okus. Uz cigaru koristite kao kratki digestif, ne kao litre kave.

Idealno nakon lagane do medium cigare.
body.en:
Ristretto is more intense than standard espresso — smaller volume, stronger taste. With cigars use as a short digestif, not litres of coffee.

Ideal after light to medium cigars.

def.hr: Kratka, deblja vitola, obično oko 4¾–5¼ inča i ring gauge 48–52.
def.en: A short, thick vitola, typically around 4¾–5¼ inches and ring gauge 48–52.

body.hr:
Robusto je moderni standard za mnoge kuće — dovoljno dima za pun profil, bez predugačke večeri. U ruci djeluje uravnotezeno.

Ring gauge varira, pa „robusto” nije jedna fiksna mjera. Uvijek provjerite točne brojeve na kutiji.

Na stolu je siguran izbor kad ne želite objašnjavati rijetke forme.
body.en:
Robusto is a modern standard for many houses — enough smoke for a full profile without a very long evening. It feels balanced in the hand.

Ring gauge varies, so robusto is not one fixed measure. Always check exact numbers on the box.

At the table it is a safe choice when you do not want to explain rare formats.

def.hr: Gotovo miješano piće u limenci ili boci — eng. ready-to-drink.
def.en: A pre-mixed drink in a can or bottle — ready-to-drink.

body.hr:
RTD su kokteli i long drinkovi koji dolaze već pomiješani: gin-tonic u limenci, slatki punch, hard seltzer i slično. Često su slađi i razblaženiji od čaše koju sami sastavite.

Uz cigaru rijetko ulaze u sparivanje — više pripadaju zabavi i brzom servisu nego večeri uz dim. Vidi i oznaku sparivosti.
body.en:
RTDs are cocktails and long drinks sold already mixed: canned G&T, sweet punch, hard seltzer and the like. They are often sweeter and more diluted than a glass you build yourself.

With cigars they rarely enter pairing — they belong more to casual fun than an evening with smoke. See also the pairable mark.

def.hr: Cigaretu motana rukom od strane torcedora, ne strojem.
def.en: Cigar rolled by hand by a roller, not machine.

body.hr:
Ručno motanje znači da je torcedor formirao bonche, stavio omotač i kapicu. Svaka cigaru je blago drugačija — ljudska varijacija.

Premium segment se oslanja na long punjenje i ručni rad. Brzina je manja, cijena viša.

Kad netko hvali „craft”, često misli na ovo.
body.en:
Hand rolling means a roller formed the bunch, applied wrapper and cap. Each cigar differs slightly — human variation.

Premium segment relies on long filler and hand work. Slower, pricier.

When someone praises craft, they often mean this.

def.hr: Whiskey s visokim udjelom raži u mash billu — začinskiji, sušiji profil od bourbona.
def.en: Whiskey with a high rye share in the mash bill — spicier, drier than bourbon.

body.hr:
Rye voli punije cigare s pepper i leather notama. Uz slatki maduro može djelovati oštro — tada mali gutljaj neat ili kratki highball.

Kanadski „rye” ponekad je pretežno kukuruz; etiketa nije uvijek doslovna.
body.en:
Rye loves fuller cigars with pepper and leather. With sweet maduro it can feel sharp — then a small neat sip or short highball.

Canadian «rye» is sometimes mostly corn; labels are not always literal.

def.hr: Meksički tamni omotač s Vallea San Andrésa, često bogat i sladak.
def.en: Dark Mexican wrapper from San Andrés Valley, often rich and sweet.

body.hr:
San Andrés (Negro) postao je omiljen u modernim blendovima — tamna boja, čokolada, zemlja, ponekad crna paprika. Deblji list daje pun dim.

Fermentacija je ključna; dobar San Andrés je sladak, loš može biti grub.

Na stolu ga spominjite kad tamni omotač nije broadleaf ni maduro iz CT.
body.en:
San Andrés (Negro) became popular in modern blends — dark colour, chocolate, earth, sometimes pepper. Thicker leaf gives full smoke.

Fermentation is key; good San Andrés is sweet, poor can be harsh.

At the table mention it when dark wrapper is neither broadleaf nor CT maduro.

def.hr: Meksiko: regija za maduro i tamne opne.
def.en: Mexico: region for maduro and dark wrappers.

body.hr:
San Andrés lišće iz južnog Meksika daje tamne, često slatko-zemljaste opne — koristi se u premium mješavina globalno. Pogodno za punije punjenje.

Ime San Andrés na bandu obećava dubinu boje i često kakao-cedar tonove.
body.en:
San Andrés leaf from southern Mexico yields dark, often sweet-earthy wrappers — used in premium blends worldwide. Suited to fuller filler.

San Andrés on the band promises depth of color and often cocoa-cedar tones.

def.hr: Whisky destiliran i odležao u Škotskoj — single malt, blended i grain.
def.en: Whisky distilled and aged in Scotland — single malt, blended and grain.

body.hr:
Scotch je široka obitelj: od laganog Speysidea do dimnog Islaya. Uz cigaru peated i sherry-matured maltovi često nose najbolji most prema dimu.

„Whisky” piše se u Škotskoj; „whiskey” u Irskoj i SAD-u.
body.en:
Scotch is a broad family: from light Speyside to smoky Islay. For cigar pairing, peated and sherry-matured malts often bridge smoke best.

«Whisky» in Scotland; «whiskey» in Ireland and the USA.

def.hr: Srednje visoki list, blaži od ligera, često doprinosi aromi i srednjem tijelu dima.
def.en: A mid-height leaf, milder than ligero, often contributing aroma and mid-body to the smoke.

body.hr:
Seco leži između jačih gornjih i lakših donjih listova. Donosi aromatičnost, malo slatkoće i ravnotežu bez prevelike težine.

U blendu seco često „veže” okus — omogućuje da se jači listovi ne ponašaju grubo. Degustator ga osjeća kao mekši srednji dio dima.

Nije glamorozan pojam za stol, ali objašnjava zašto neka punja imaju mekši, cvjetniji srednji dio.
body.en:
Seco sits between stronger upper and lighter lower leaves. It brings aromatics, a touch of sweetness, and balance without excessive weight.

In a blend seco often binds the flavour — allowing stronger leaves to behave without harshness. The taster feels it as a softer middle third.

It is not a flashy table term, but it explains why some fillers have a gentler, more floral middle.

def.hr: Navlaživanje unutarnjeg cedra prije prvog punjenja.
def.en: Moistening interior cedar before first loading.

body.hr:
Seasoning podiže cedar da zadrži RH umjesto da odmah isuši cigare. Klasičan postupak: lagana destilirana voda ili Boveda 84 % u praznom humidoru nekoliko dana, zatim stabilizacija na ciljnom RH.

Preskočiti seasoning znači da nove cigare brzo gube vlagu dok drvo ne nasiti. Strpljenje na početku štedi zalihe.
body.en:
Seasoning prepares cedar to hold RH instead of instantly drying cigars. Classic method: light distilled water or an 84% Boveda in an empty humidor for several days, then stabilize at target RH.

Skipping seasoning means new cigars lose moisture until wood saturates. Patience upfront saves stock.

def.hr: Fortificirano vino iz Jereza — spektar od suhog fino do slatkog PX.
def.en: Fortified wine from Jerez — spectrum from dry fino to sweet PX.

body.hr: Za razliku od porta, osnovni sherry se prvo potpuno fermentira, pa se zatim fortificira — zato počinje suh, a slatkoća (cream, PX) dolazi kasnijim dodacima. Solera i flor (fino/manzanilla) ili oksidacija (oloroso) grade stil.\n\nFino uz laganu cigaru; oloroso uz punu; PX uz desert i maduro. Servirajte hladnije nego crveno vino; mala čaša je dovoljna.
body.en: Unlike port, base sherry is fully fermented first, then fortified — so it starts dry, and sweetness (cream, PX) comes from later additions. Solera plus flor (fino/manzanilla) or oxidation (oloroso) build the style.\n\nFino with light cigars; oloroso with full; PX with dessert and maduro. Serve cooler than red wine; a small glass suffices.

def.hr: Whisky iz jedne destilerije, isključivo od ječmenog slada.
def.en: Whisky from one distillery, made only from malted barley.

body.hr:
Single malt ne znači automatski „bolji” od blenda — znači jedinstven profil destilerije. Pri sparivanju istražite regiju: Islay i Speyside daju suprotan rezultat.

Cask strength single malt traži vodu ili strpljenje.
body.en:
Single malt does not automatically mean «better» than blend — it means one distillery's profile. For pairing, region matters: Islay vs Speyside give opposite results.

Cask strength single malt wants water or patience.

def.hr: Koliko piće nosi šećer ili slatku iluziju — ključ uz gorak ili pun dim.
def.en: How much sugar or sweet illusion the drink carries — key beside bitter or full smoke.

body.hr: Slatkoća smiruje oštar rub dima, ali previše je smiruje i pretvara večer u desert prije deserta. Umjerena slatkoća dobro radi s punim madurom i s biljnim digestivima; agresivna slatkoća guši suptilne pokrove.
body.en: Sweetness softens smoke's sharp edge, but too much softens it into dessert before dessert arrives. Moderate sweetness works well with full maduro and with herbal digestifs; aggressive sweetness muffles subtle wrappers.

def.hr: Broj i promjena nijansi okusa kroz dim.
def.en: The number and shift of flavor nuances through the smoke.

body.hr:
Složena cigaru ne drži jedan okus cijelo vrijeme — prelazi iz kakaoa u orašaste note, pa u crni papar, pa u cedar. To ne znači bolja automatski, ali nagrađuje pažnju.

Jednostavna, konzistentna cigaru može biti savršena za opuštanje; složenost je degustacijski izazov.
body.en:
A complex cigar does not hold one flavor throughout — it moves from cocoa to nuts to black pepper to cedar. That does not automatically mean better, but it rewards attention.

A simple, steady cigar can be perfect for relaxation; complexity is a tasting challenge.

def.hr: Zaobljena čaša s uskim vrhom — koncentrira aromu brandyja i cognaca.
def.en: Rounded glass with narrow rim — concentrates brandy and cognac aroma.

body.hr:
Snifter je stol za cognac, armagnac i stariji rum. Zagrijte čašu dlanom blago — aroma prema nosu, gutljaj malen.

Uz cigaru snifter naglašava suho voće prije nego dim „preuzme”.
body.en:
Snifter is the table glass for cognac, armagnac and older rum. Warm the bowl gently in the palm — aroma to the nose, sip small.

With cigars a snifter highlights dried fruit before smoke «takes over».

def.hr: Prostor s kontroliranom vlagom i temperaturom za odležavanje gotovih cigara.
def.en: Room with controlled humidity and temperature for resting finished cigars.

body.hr:
Soba za starenje — ne isto što i humidor kod kuće — koristi se u tvornici prije izlaska na tržište. Cigare odležavaju nakon motanja i pakiranja.

Cilj je ujednačiti vlagu u bonchu i spojiti okus. Kratko starenje je standard; dugo je luksuz.

Na stolu objašnjava zašto svježa serija ponekad „sede” nakon nekoliko mjeseci u humidoru.
body.en:
An aging room — not the same as home humidor — is used at the factory before release. Cigars rest after rolling and packing.

Goal is to even moisture in the bunch and marry flavour. Short aging is standard; long is luxury.

At the table it explains why a fresh batch sometimes settles after months in your humidor.

def.hr: Sustav starenja gdje se mlađe destilati miješaju sa starijim u kaskadi bačvi.
def.en: An aging system where younger distillates blend with older stocks in a cascade of casks.

body.hr:
Prava solera — kao kod sherryja — rijetka je u rumu; mnoge „solera” etikete označavaju stil miješanja, ne dokaz godina.

Solera-rumovi često nose orašaste note koje prate maduro pokrov.
body.en:
True solera — as in sherry — is rare in rum; many «solera» labels denote blending style, not proof of age.

Solera rums often carry nutty notes that suit maduro wrappers.

def.hr: Oznaka gdje broj prije plusa znači godine u rumu, a broj poslije plusa godine u sherry bačvi.
def.en: A label where the number before the plus is years in rum casks, and the number after is years in sherry casks.

body.hr:
Dos Maderas 5+3 ne znači „osam godina” na jednom mjestu — znači pet godina u rum bačvama, zatim tri u sherry bačvama. Takva oznaka opisuje put, ne jednu kalendarsku starost.

Pri čitanju etikete
• Plus je most između dviju faza — ne zbrajaj brojeve kao da su isti tip starenja.
• Sherry faza dodaje orašaste i suho-voćne note koje često prate maduro pokrov.
• Usporedba s „12 years” rumom — druga logika; pitaj što je stvarno u bačvi, ne samo zbroj.

U aplikaciji
• Polje starosti i opis stila pomažu razlikovati solera, dvostruku bačvu i marketinški broj na etiketi.
body.en:
Dos Maderas 5+3 does not mean «eight years» in one place — it means five years in rum casks, then three in sherry casks. The notation describes a path, not a single calendar age.

Reading the label
• The plus bridges two phases — do not add the numbers as if they were the same kind of aging.
• The sherry phase adds nutty and dried-fruit notes that often suit maduro wrappers.
• Compared with a «12 years» rum — different logic; ask what was actually in the cask, not only the sum.

In the app
• Age fields and style notes help separate solera, double-cask and marketing numbers on the label.

def.hr: Dozvoljeni karamelni aditiv koji tamni rum — ne mijenja sam po sebi okus, ali utječe na očekivanja.
def.en: Permitted caramel additive that darkens rum — it does not automatically change taste, but it shapes expectations.

body.hr:
E150a je karamel boja dopuštena u rumu (i u scotch whiskyju). Tamnija boča ne znači automatski stariji destilat — ponekad je samo boja.

Što provjeriti
• Tamni rum bez deklaracije starosti — boja može biti stil, ne dokaz godina.
• U EU rumu dopušten je i dodani šećer do granice — boja i slatkoća nisu isto pitanje.
• „Bez aditiva” / transparentne kuće — stilski izbor, ne moralna ocjena.

Pri sparivanju
• Previše očekivanja od tamne boje može zavarati nepce — slušaj okus, ne nijansu stakla.
• Slađi, tamniji rum — zalijepi zadnju trećinu; uz Connecticut traži čistiji profil.
body.en:
E150a is caramel colour permitted in rum (and in Scotch whisky). A darker bottle does not automatically mean older spirit — sometimes it is only colour.

What to check
• Dark rum without a declared age — colour may be style, not proof of years.
• In EU rum, added sugar is also allowed within limits — colour and sweetness are not the same question.
• «No additives» / transparent houses — a stylistic choice, not a moral verdict.

When pairing
• Expecting depth from colour alone can fool the palate — listen to taste, not glass hue.
• Sweeter, darker rum can glue the final third; with Connecticut, look for a cleaner profile.

def.hr: Rum gdje je glavna priča destilerija i stil bačve, a ne marketinški blend bez lica.
def.en: Rum where the distillery and cask style lead the story, not an anonymous marketing blend.

body.hr:
Distillery-first znači da etiketa nosi ime destilerije i stil (npr. Foursquare, Doorly's): znaš tko je destilirao, kako je stario i što je u staklu. Suprotno su generički „Caribbean blend” bez adrese.

Za stol
• Foursquare — Barbados, često jasna deklaracija bačve i starosti; dobar model za učenje bez aditiva.
• Doorly's — isti kućni stil, pristupačniji ulaz; XO i 12 YO često nose orašaste note uz maduro.
• Usporedba s „solera” rumom — ovdje je put destilerije, ne samo slatkoća miješanja.

Pri sparivanju
• Čistiji profil lakše se čita uz Connecticut ili srednju Habano cigaru.
• Cask strength iz iste kuće traži puniju cigaru ili kap vode — isto pravilo kao za whisky.
body.en:
Distillery-first means the label carries the distillery and style (e.g. Foursquare, Doorly's): you know who distilled, how it aged and what is in the glass. The opposite is a generic «Caribbean blend» with no address.

At the table
• Foursquare — Barbados, often clear cask and age statements; a good model for learning without additives.
• Doorly's — same house style, an easier entry; XO and 12 YO often carry nutty notes with maduro.
• Compared with «solera» rum — here the distillery path matters, not only blending sweetness.

When pairing
• Cleaner profiles read more easily with Connecticut or a medium Habano cigar.
• Cask strength from the same house wants a fuller cigar or a drop of water — same rule as whisky.

def.hr: Različito piće ili naglasak kroz prvu, srednju i završnu trećinu cigare.
def.en: Different drinks or accents through the first, middle, and final third of the cigar.

body.hr: Cigara se mijenja dok je pušite; stol može pratiti tu promjenu. Prva trećina često traži svježiji gutljaj, srednja puninu, završna mir ili kontrast. Nije obavezno — ali pokazuje da slušate dim, ne samo katalog.
body.en: A cigar changes as you smoke it; the table can follow that shift. The first third often wants a fresher sip, the middle wants weight, the finish wants calm or contrast. It is not mandatory — but it shows you are listening to the smoke, not only the catalog.

def.hr: Rum aromatiziran začinskim sastojcima — vanilija, cimet, citrus kora.
def.en: Rum flavoured with spices — vanilla, cinnamon, citrus peel.

body.hr: Spiced rum je desertni partner. Uz cigaru radi kad cigare već nose slatkoću ili začin; uz suhu ligu može djelovati prenatrpano.
body.en: Spiced rum is a dessert partner. With cigars it works when the cigar already carries sweetness or spice; with dry ligero it can feel cluttered.

def.hr: Srednji list koji drži punjenje zajedno i pomaže oblikovanju boncha prije omotača.
def.en: The middle leaf that holds the filler together and helps shape the bunch before the wrapper is applied.

body.hr:
Capote je strukturalni sloj: manje vidljiv od omotača, ali važan za čvrstoću i ravnomjerno gorenje. Obično je nešto deblji i elastičniji od vanjskog lista.

U okusu vezni list rijetko dominira; ipak doprinosi punini i stabilnosti dima. Slabije uvezan bonche može goreti neravnomjerno.

Za stol je dovoljno znati da vezni list drži cigaru u obliku — poput kostura ispod vidljive površine.
body.en:
The binder is a structural layer: less visible than the wrapper, yet important for firmness and even burn. It is usually slightly thicker and more elastic than the outer leaf.

In flavour the binder rarely dominates; it still adds body and smoke stability. A poorly bound bunch may burn unevenly.

At the table it is enough to know the binder holds the cigar in shape — like a frame beneath the surface.

def.hr: Odmaranje fermentiranog duhana u kontroliranim uvjetima prije motanja.
def.en: Resting fermented tobacco in controlled conditions before rolling.

body.hr:
Starenje nakon fermentacije smiruje okus — oštri rubovi se zaoblju, note se spajaju. Neke kuće staraju listove mjesecima ili godinama.

Nije isto što i starenje gotove cigare, ali oba koraka grade dubinu. Mlad duhan može biti jak, ali grub.

Kad etiketa kaže „aged tobacco”, misli se često na ovaj korak.
body.en:
Post-fermentation aging smooths flavour — sharp edges round, notes marry. Some houses age leaf for months or years.

Not the same as aging finished cigars, but both build depth. Young leaf can be strong but rough.

When label says aged tobacco, it often means this step.

def.hr: Rum u hrastu razvija boju, tanine i slatkoću — često ex-bourbon ili sherry bačve.
def.en: Rum in oak develops colour, tannin and sweetness — often ex-bourbon or sherry casks.

body.hr:
Tropik ubrzava interakciju s drvetom. Sherry cask rum voli maduro; ex-bourbon voli kremu i orahe u cigari.

„Barrel aged” bez broja godina nije dokaz kvalitete.
body.en:
The tropics accelerate wood interaction. Sherry-cask rum loves maduro; ex-bourbon loves cream and nuts in the cigar.

«Barrel aged» without stated years is not proof of quality.

def.hr: Kraj cigare koji se pali; može biti otvoren ili zatvoren.
def.en: The end of the cigar that is lit; it may be open or closed.

body.hr:
Stopa je strana koja ide u plamen. Otvorena stopa olakšava paljenje; zatvorena traži više strpljenja, ali može obećati bogatiji prvi dim.

Pri paljenju rotirajte cigaru iznad plamena, bez žurbe. Stopa otkriva koliko je punjenje ujednačeno — neravnomjerno gorenje često počinje ovdje.

Na stolu stopa je praktičan pojam: „Palim stopu, ne glavu.”
body.en:
The foot is the lit end. An open foot lights easily; a closed foot needs patience but may promise a richer first draw.

When lighting, rotate the cigar above the flame without rushing. The foot reveals how even the filler is — uneven burn often starts here.

At the table the foot is practical: I light the foot, not the head.

def.hr: Cigaretu formirana strojem, često kratko punjenje i HTL omotač.
def.en: Cigar formed by machine, often short filler and HTL wrapper.

body.hr:
Machine-made cigare imaju svoje mjesto — jeftinije, ujednačene, brže. Konstrukcija je drugačija od ručnog rada.

Okus može biti prihvatljiv za svakodnevicu, ali nije isti ritual ni slojevitost. Nema tu triple cap ni selekcije listova.

Bez snobizma: radi se o namjeni, ne o moralnoj superiornosti.
body.en:
Machine-made cigars have their place — cheaper, uniform, fast. Construction differs from hand work.

Flavour can be fine for daily use, but not same ritual or layering. No triple cap or leaf selection story.

Without snobbery: it is about purpose, not moral superiority.

def.hr: Od light do dark roast — koliko su zrna pržena određuje gorčinu i tijelo kave.
def.en: From light to dark roast — how long beans are roasted sets bitterness and body.

body.hr:
Dark roast + puna cigara = dvostruka gorčina i dim — pazite na balans. Medium roast često najbolji most uz habano.

Light roast je voćniji, manje „kava uz dim” klasičan.
body.en:
Dark roast + full cigar = double bitterness and smoke — watch balance. Medium roast is often the best habano bridge.

Light roast is fruitier, less classic «coffee with smoke».

def.hr: Kad dim i piće u istom trenutku guše jedan drugoga — ne namjerni kontrast.
def.en: When smoke and drink mute each other at once — not deliberate contrast.

body.hr: Sukob nije moralna greška; to je signal za promjenu. Promijenite piće, skratite dim ili umetnite reset. Forsiranje sukoba jer „treba probati” jedino stvara neugodu kod gosta koji ne voli dramu.
body.en: Clash is not a moral fault; it is a signal to change something. Switch the drink, shorten the smoke, or insert a reset. Forcing clash because "we should try it" only creates discomfort for guests who dislike drama.

def.hr: Kad dimni, tresetni whisky pregazi suptilniju cigaru ili već zasićen nepce.
def.en: When smoky, peaty whisky overruns a subtler cigar or an already saturated palate.

body.hr: Treset nije greška — ali je glas. Uz Connecticut ili blagi Dominican blend često postane jedini okus u prostoriji. Ako volite treset, birajte cigara koji može odgovoriti puninom, ne samo dimom.
body.en: Peat is not a mistake — but it is loud. Beside Connecticut or a mild Dominican blend it often becomes the only flavor in the room. If you love peat, choose a cigar that can answer with weight, not only with smoke.

def.hr: Kad tannin iz vina i sušenje dima udaraju u isti rub tanjura.
def.en: When wine tannin and smoke drying hit the same edge of the palate.

body.hr: Tannin clash osjećate kao pijesak i gorko istovremeno — nije „jak okus”, nego neugoda. Pri stolu je bolje promijeniti vino nego forsirati cigaru. Suha crna s Habanom pokrovom čest je kandidat za ovaj sukob.
body.en: Tannin clash feels like grit and bitterness at once — not "bold flavor," but discomfort. At the table, change the wine rather than force the cigar. Dry red with Habano wrapper is a frequent candidate.

def.hr: Početno sušenje svježih listova u šupi ili kući nakon berbe.
def.en: Initial drying of fresh leaves in barns or houses after harvest.

body.hr:
Curing je prvi korak nakon berbe — list gubi vlagu, mijenja boju, postaje plastičan umjesto krhkog. Bez njega nema fermentacije.

Način sušenja (sun, air, flue) utječe na boju i kasnji okus. Candela koristi drugačiji curing nego maduro.

Na stolu curing je pozadina; degustacija je fermentacija i blend.
body.en:
Curing is the first step after harvest — leaf loses moisture, changes colour, becomes pliable not brittle. Without it, no fermentation.

Curing method (sun, air, flue) affects colour and later flavour. Candela uses different curing than maduro.

At the table curing is background; tasting is fermentation and blend.

def.hr: Polifenoli iz koštica, ljuske i hrastove bačve — sušenje, struktura u vinu.
def.en: Polyphenols from seeds, skins and oak — drying structure in wine.

body.hr:
Tanin u vinu paralelan je s punoćom cigare. Visoki tanin voli puni ligero; niski tanin voli connecticut.

Sherry i port imaju drugačiju strukturu — vidi sherry, port.
body.en:
Wine tannin parallels cigar body. High tannin loves full ligero; low tannin loves Connecticut.

Sherry and port have different structure — see sherry, port.

def.hr: Američki whiskey blizak bourbonu, dodatno filtriran kroz javorov ugljen (Lincoln County Process).
def.en: American whiskey close to bourbon, additionally filtered through maple charcoal (Lincoln County Process).

body.hr: Tennessee whiskey dijeli kukuruznu bazu i nove opaljene bačve s bourbonom, ali ugljena filtracija daje mekši, često „slađi” profil.\n\nUz cigara: sličan izbor kao bourbon — medium do full, cedar i karamela. Ne zamijeniti s peated scotchem.
body.en: Tennessee whiskey shares corn base and new charred oak with bourbon, but charcoal filtration yields a softer, often «sweeter» profile.\n\nWith cigars: similar pick to bourbon — medium to full, cedar and caramel. Do not confuse with peated Scotch.

def.hr: Koliko dim ispunjava prostor i nepce — od gotovo prozračnog do sobnog.
def.en: How much smoke fills the room and the palate — from nearly airy to room-filling.

body.hr: Težina dima nije isto što i jačina cigare. Lagani dim može imati pun okus, a teški dim može dolaziti iz tanke vitole. Ventilacija i ritam pušenja mijenjaju dojam jednako kao blend.
body.en: Smoke weight is not the same as cigar strength. Light smoke can carry full flavor; heavy smoke can come from a slim vitola. Ventilation and smoking pace change the impression as much as the blend.

def.hr: Osjećaj težine i punoće vina u ustima — od laganog do punog.
def.en: Sense of weight and fullness in the mouth — from light to full.

body.hr:
Tijelo vina treba pratiti tijelo cigare. Lagano vino uz punu cigaru nestaje; puno vino uz laganu cigaru dominira.

Aplikacija koristi sličnu logiku u ocjenama.
body.en:
Wine body should track cigar body. Light wine + full cigar = wine vanishes; full wine + light cigar = wine dominates.

The pairing app uses similar logic in scores.

def.hr: Nešto duža i često deblja vitola od robusta, obično oko 6 inča.
def.en: A somewhat longer and often thicker vitola than robusto, typically around 6 inches.

body.hr:
Toro nudi više vremena za razvoj okusa — više srednjeg dijela, sporiji tempo. Deblji profil može dati hladniji dim.

Nije univerzalno definiran; neki toro su bliži robustu, drugi gotovo gordo.

Korisno kad želite „punu večeru” bez churchilla.
body.en:
Toro offers more time for flavour to develop — more middle third, slower pace. A thicker profile can give cooler smoke.

Not universally defined; some toros sit near robusto, others almost gordo.

Useful when you want a full evening without a Churchill.

def.hr: Figurado s izraženim suženjem prema glavi, sličan piramidi, ali često s blagom kapicom.
def.en: A figurado with pronounced taper toward the head, similar to pyramid but often with a slight cap.

body.hr:
Torpedo je vizualno dramatičan — sužava se prema vrhu, pa prvi dim može biti koncentriraniji. Rezanje je ključno.

Pogrešan rez može učiniti glavu preuska ili preširoka. Umjereno rezanje na vrhu suženja.

Na stolu je razgovor o formi i preciznosti noža.
body.en:
Torpedo looks dramatic — it narrows toward the top, so early draw can feel concentrated. Cutting is key.

Wrong cut makes the head too narrow or too open. Cut modestly at the taper tip.

At the table it is talk about form and knife precision.

def.hr: Zagrijavanje foota bez punog paljenja.
def.en: Heating the foot without fully igniting it.

body.hr:
Tostiranje je prvi korak paljenja: plamen kruži blizu foota dok se rub tamni i dim mirno izlazi. Cilj je ravnomjerno zagrijati punjenje prije punog gorenja.

Preskočiti toasting i odmah zapaliti foot često daje neravno gorenje i oštar start.
body.en:
Toasting is the first lighting step: flame circles near the foot until the edge darkens and smoke rises calmly. Goal is even heat before full combustion.

Skipping toast and instantly torching the foot often yields uneven burn and a harsh start.

def.hr: Papirnata traka oko tijela cigare s imenom marke, linije ili vitole.
def.en: The paper ring around the cigar body bearing brand, line, or vitola name.

body.hr:
Traka je vizitka cigare — prvi pisani trag tko je napravio što. Nije samo ukras: pomaže identificirati seriju kad su cigare u humidoru bez kutije.

Neke trake su sekundarne, posebne serije ili godišnji izdanja. Skidanje prije pušenja stvar je ukusa; neki je ostavljaju da ne oštete omotač.

Na stolu traka olakšava razgovor: „Ovo je ista linija, druga veličina.”
body.en:
The band is the cigar's calling card — the first written clue to who made what. It is not mere decoration: it helps identify a line when cigars sit in the humidor without boxes.

Some bands are secondary, special releases, or annual editions. Removing before smoking is a matter of taste; some leave it to avoid damaging the wrapper.

At the table the band makes conversation easier: same line, different size.

def.hr: Podjela dima na prvu, srednju i završnu trećinu.
def.en: Dividing the smoke into first, second, and final thirds.

body.hr:
Prva trećina obično donosi najsvježije note i ponekad jači nikotin; srednja gradi profil; završna trećina najdublje i najtoplije gori — pazite na temperaturu.

Ova podjela pomaže u degustacijskim bilješkama, iako granice nisu matematičke.
body.en:
The first third usually brings the freshest notes and sometimes sharper nicotine; the second builds the profile; the final third burns deepest and hottest — watch temperature.

This division aids tasting notes, though boundaries are not mathematical.

def.hr: Ručno ugrađena kapica od tri sloja omotača, znak pažljivog završnog rada.
def.en: A hand-applied cap of three wrapper layers, a sign of careful finishing work.

body.hr:
